About Impact Recruiting Solutions:

Impact Recruiting Solutions is a dedicated recruitment partner connecting healthcare professionals with rewarding opportunities. We collaborate with hospitals, clinics, and multi-specialty facilities to match skilled individuals with roles that align with their expertise and career aspirations.

Position Overview

Impact Recruiting Solutions is looking for a skilled and compassionate Neurologist to join a well-established clinic located in Brooklyn, NY. In this role, you will diagnose and treat a wide range of neurological disorders, providing comprehensive care to a diverse patient population while working collaboratively with a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Diagnose and treat a wide range of neurological disorders, including but not limited to epilepsy, stroke, migraine, neuropathy, and movement disorders.
  • Perform comprehensive neurological examinations and interpret diagnostic studies such as EEG, EMG, MRI, and CT scans.
  • Perform and interpret specialized diagnostic procedures including Echocardiograms, Carotid Doppler, Lower Extremity Venous Doppler, and Abdominal Aortic Doppler.
  • Develop and manage individualized treatment plans, including prescribing medications and coordinating referrals for specialized care or surgical interventions.
  • Educate patients and their families on neurological conditions, treatment options, and strategies for managing symptoms and improving quality of life.
  • Collaborate with primary care physicians, specialists, and allied health professionals to coordinate comprehensive patient care.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and thorough documentation in the electronic medical record.
  • Stay current with advancements in neurology through continuing education and participation in professional development activities

Requirements

  • Education: MD or DO degree from an accredited medical school. Completion of an accredited residency program in Neurology.
  • Licensure: Active and unrestricted New York State medical license.
  • Certification: Board Certified in Neurology.
  • Experience: Open to new graduates.
  • Language: Bilingual in Russian required.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in Electronic Medical Records (EMR) and Electronic Health Records (EHR) systems. Proficient in performing neurological examinations, interpreting diagnostic studies (EEG, EMG, MRI, CT), and managing treatment plans for various neurological conditions.
  • Soft Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a compassionate and patient-centered approach. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to work both independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a highly competitive annual salary ranging from $350,000 to $400,000, commensurate with experience.
  • Comprehensive Benefits:
    • Health and Liability Insurance covered
    • 3 weeks vacation
    • 401k plan (TBD)
  • Work Schedule: This is a stable, full-time position offering consistency and work-life balance.
  • Professional Growth: Gain valuable experience in a collaborative, innovative, and supportive environment, working alongside experienced specialists and healthcare professionals.
  • Impactful Work: Contribute to a mission-driven organization dedicated to improving patient outcomes by providing expert neurological care to the Brooklyn community.

About the job

Job summary

Please refer to Job Description

Job description

Are you passionate about rehabilitation? Could you help people make meaningful and sustained changes in their lives? If so, then a career as a Programme Facilitator in the Probation Service is for you.
If this sounds like you, apply now.
Providing interventions to people who engage in harmful behaviour to help reduce their likelihood of reoffending is an important part of our work in HMPPS. Our Programme Facilitators deliver a range of Accredited Programmes and Structured Interventions. You will be delivering groupwork and individual work to people subject to Community Orders or on licence after release from prison. These programmes are designed to support people to desist from crime, help people build on their strengths and lead more fulfilling and pro-social lives. You will be working with people who have perpetrated domestic abuse, sexual abuse and/or committed other violent and acquisitive offences.
The majority of our Programmes are delivered in the evening and therefore evening work is essential in this role. You will also travel to different locations to your office base to deliver these programmes. Travel expenses can be claimed.
If you are successful in the recruitment process to join the Probation Service, your starting salary will be £28,064
In addition to the base salary, you will be entitled to unsocial hours payments for working in the evenings and/or a Saturday. Working on a Saturday attracts an additional premium of 50% and working evenings an additional 30%.
The Probation Service offers the opportunity for annual pay progression through a Competency Based Framework (CBF), which if eligible, will see your pay increase. CBF is designed to enable you to move up through the pay band range as your competence grows.
New entrants are expected to join on the minimum of the pay band.
Probation Service also increase their pay band ranges annually in line with Civil Service Pay guidance, which will also apply an increase to band pay ranges where applicable.
Overview of the job
The job holder will deliver a range of rehabilitation interventions aimed at changing the attitudes, beliefs, and behaviour of people on probation with a full range of offence types and a full range of levels of risks (including those convicted of sexual and domestic abuse offences), as determined by sentences of the Courts and on the recommendation of Probation Practitioners.
The main objectives of this role are to reduce re-offending, protect the public, prevent future victims and rehabilitation to help people to build constructive and meaningful lives in the community, through the delivery of effective evidence based Accredited Programmes and Structured Interventions.
The post holder will be Regionally based and sit in the Interventions Team and report to the Programme Manager. They will deliver interventions across a large regional area where travel will be required. There will be no line management responsibility in this role.
There will be a requirement to regularly work unsocial hours (including evenings and weekends).
For further information on the summary, responsibilities, activities, duties of the role and the Civil Service Success Profile Criteria which will be used in the assessment process, please refer to the full Job Description Attachment.
Right to work in the UK
You must have the right to work in the UK and Civil Service ().
Skilled Worker visa changes from 22 July 2025
In accordance with current immigration rules, this role is not eligible for a new Skilled Worker visa.
From 22 July 2025, the Government introduced changes to the eligibility criteria for Skilled Worker visas. As a result:
HM Prison and Probation Service (HMPPS) cannot consider sponsoring you to work as a programme facilitator unless you have held a Skilled Worker visa prior to the 22 July 2025 changes.
If you have held a Skilled Worker visa continuously, please raise this during your pre-employment checks and your eligibility will be assessed in accordance with the immigration rules and transitional provisions in place.
If you apply to be a programme facilitator and you have not held a Skilled Worker visa prior to 22 July 2025, you will need to consider your options for obtaining and/or maintaining your right to work in the UK in light of these changes.
If your application is successful, you will need to ensure that you have and maintain the legal right to live and work in the Civil Service and in the United Kingdom.
HMPPS will continue to comply with UK Immigration Rules applied in the UK and Civil Service. You can read more about Skilled Worker visas and the eligibility criteria here.
Civil Service recruitment: nationality rules
Civil Service

You can read more about Skilled Worker visas and the eligibility criteria here ()
About us:
The work is varied, challenging and meaningful and comes with job security, great benefits and career progression opportunities - not to mention the chance to make a real difference to people’s lives and our communities.
About the Recruitment Process
To apply to this role you will be required to complete a short application form and detail responses to two Civil Service Behaviour and one Experience based questions.
Your application will be sifted once the application deadline has closed. You will then receive further instruction on the outcome of your application.
If successful at sift you will be invited to an interview which will include a facilitation exercise.
The purpose of the assessment process is to assess the right behaviours and strengths required for the programme facilitator role and to assess your suitability for the training programme that is required for the role.
The assessment will consist of two activities: A facilitation exercise with some follow up questions (topic will be emailed to you once interview booked) and an interview relating to the role of a programme facilitator
For the facilitation exercise you will need to prepare a presentation, the topic of which will be shared with you once you book an interview slot.
The facilitation exercise will be measuring you against the behaviours of Communicating and Influencing, Developing Self and Others and Managing a Quality Service. You will have up to 10 minutes to deliver the exercise.
If we receive a high volume of applications, we may assess and progress candidates through the recruitment process in stages (tranches). Candidates who meet the required standard at sift may be held pending future assessment stages rather than progressing immediately. Interview invitations and subsequent offers will be managed in line with the tranche in which candidates are assessed and their position in merit order
If you apply for multiple vacancies for the same role, only one of your applications will be progressed. Any assessment scores achieved will be applied consistently across all applications for that role, this will be valid for 6 months.
Candidates who do not meet the minimum benchmark at either the Sift or Interview stage will not be eligible to reapply for the same role for six months from the date their assessment scores are progressed. There is also no guarantee that you will progress to the next stages of the recruitment process; however, we will keep you informed at each stage.
About the role
Helping offenders turn their lives around isn’t without its challenges. But you’ll play a key role in supporting them through interventions that encourage positive change.
As a programme facilitator, you’ll deliver group and one-to-one sessions, creating a safe and structured environment that meets different learning styles and needs. You’ll manage group dynamics, address challenging behaviour, and ensure sessions remain effective.
Our team is made up of a strong and inclusive group of colleagues, from all walks of life, who are passionate about helping and motivating people on probation. You will work alongside your fellow team members to ensure that people on probation receive the highest quality input and support, as well as sharing information and providing guidance to members of the wider Probation Service, such as Probation Practitioners and Domestic Abuse Safety Officers.
You’ll also:
Monitor progress, risk, and wellbeing throughout the intervention
Keep accurate records and share insights with relevant teams
Work closely with courts and criminal justice agencies to support sentence management
Provide workshops and briefings to probation staff and external stakeholders
Use pro-social modelling to reinforce positive behaviours
With regular feedback and professional development, you’ll have the support you need to grow in your role while making a real difference in people’s lives.
Due to the nature of the role extensive training and support is provided to ensure that all Programme Facilitators are confident and competent to succeed. Through the training programme you will learn about all aspects of programme delivery, including the theory behind the interventions we deliver. It is a requirement to successfully complete a 6-month probationary period, including undertaking an assessment centre and passing assessed training.
The majority of our programmes are delivered in the evening and therefore evening work is essential in this role. You will also travel to different locations to your office base to deliver these programmes. Travel expenses can be claimed.

title: Senior Technical Project Manager (NYC)
description:
CoinDesk is the most trusted media, events, indices and data company for the global crypto economy. Since 2013, CoinDesk Media has led the story of the future of money and investing, illuminating the transformation in society and culture that comes with it. Our award-winning team of journalists delivers news and unparalleled insights that bring transparency, comprehension and context. CoinDesk Events gathers the global crypto, blockchain and Web3 communities at annual events such as Consensus, the world’s largest and longest-running crypto festival. CoinDesk Indices offers expertise in digital asset indices, data and research to educate and empower investors. For more information on CoinDesk media and events, please visit http://coindesk.com [coindesk.com] and for breaking headlines, data and indices visit http://coindeskmarkets.com [coindeskmarkets.com]

In November 2023, CoinDesk was acquired by the Bullish group, owner of Bullish, a regulated, digital assets exchange. For more information on Bullish, please visit . CoinDesk operates as an independent subsidiary with an editorial committee to protect journalistic independence.

Reports to:

Director - PMO, Change & Delivery

Position Overview

Bullish is redefining the capital markets infrastructure by bridging traditional equity systems with blockchain-based tokenization. To drive this vision forward, we are seeking a Senior Technical Project Manager to bring the core business platform & services of a blue-chip, financial institution into Bullish’s advanced technical ecosystem. You will own the end-to-end delivery of complex, high-stakes engineering projects and large-scale data migrations into our modern architecture.

This is a highly unique and impactful opportunity. The work you do here will directly impact the future state of our combined business, and position Bullish as an enduring leader in the next chapter of capital markets infrastructure. If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

Technical Program Execution:

  • Design the roadmap and execution plan for the platform build out. Work closely with geo-distributed, cross-functional teams to transform architectural concepts into actionable, scheduled engineering backlogs.

  • Establish clear migration roadmaps, sequencing plans, and cutover strategies to migrate core business services from legacy environments without disrupting active financial operations.

  • Manage technical project scopes, delivery schedules, and resource allocations using modern Agile, Scrum, and Kanban frameworks.

Architecture Alignment & Data Strategy:

  • Drive complex data migration initiatives transferring high-volume PII, sensitive financial records, and historical transaction datasets from multiple legacy systems into Bullish’s secure, scalable infrastructure while ensuring zero loss of data integrity and adhering to local regulations.

  • Partner closely with Staff Engineers, Systems Architects, and Data Engineers to review data schemas, API contracts, ETL pipeline architectures, and cloud storage designs.

  • Work with Security teams to ensure all data migration workflows adhere to strict encryption, auditing, and access control requirements.

  • Identify technical debt, legacy dependencies, and architectural risks early, driving alignment on technical trade-offs and mitigation strategies.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

  • Act as the primary technical bridge between executive leadership, engineering, product, design, legal, compliance, and risk teams across both businesses.

  • Translate intricate regulatory requirements and technical risks into clear executive summaries and operational dashboards for senior leadership.

  • Maintain transparent project health metrics, dependencies trackers, and risk matrices.

Process Optimization & Governance

  • Work with Engineering Leads to drive continuous improvement across sprint planning, dependency mapping, and release management processes across multiple engineering tracks.

  • Define and track key quantitative delivery metrics (e.g., velocity, migration accuracy rates, system latency, burndown metrics).

  • Organize post-mortems and retrospectives to capture key insights and optimize repeatable integration frameworks for future business expansion.

Experience & Qualifications:

  • Experience: 6+ years of direct experience as a Technical Program/Project Manager leading software engineering, platform modernizations, or complex infrastructure integrations.

  • Domain Expertise: Proven experience delivering technical projects within regulated financial platforms & services (FinTech, capital markets, banking, or crypto/digital assets).

  • Data Migration Experience: Demonstrated hands-on leadership of large-scale data migrations involving regulated datasets across disparate systems; PII, financial transaction records, etc.

  • Technical Background: Knowledge in modern cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure), microservices architecture, distributed databases, APIs, and data security frameworks.

  • Methodologies: Agile development methodologies and enterprise tools (Jira, Confluence, Linear).

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent technical experience.

Preferred:

  • Prior experience navigating M&A integrations, technical consolidation or migration, or system deprecation efforts.

  • Industry certifications such as PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, or AWS Certified Solutions Architect / Cloud Practitioner.

  • Familiarity with financial compliance frameworks (ITIL, SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA, AML/KYC systems, PCI-DSS).

Bullish US LLC & CoinDesk Inc. are committed to offering competitive compensation and benefits. The anticipated base salary for this position is $190,000 – $220,000 + discretionary annual target bonus + performance incentives/benefits. Offered salary will be reflective of job-related knowledge, skills, and commensurate experience.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

In an effort to attract, retain, develop and promote the most qualified individuals, CoinDesk is committed to treating all applicants and employees in a nondiscriminatory manner with respect to the terms and conditions of employment, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status/service, physical or mental disability, or any other classification protected by applicable law. This mandate governs all aspects of employment, including recruitment, selection, promotion, training, education, social and recreation programs, compensation, discipline, termination and access to benefits.

ACCOMMODATION

CoinDesk is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the application process, please send an e-mail to recruiting@coindesk.com and let us know the nature of your request.

title: Director Revenue Cycle Applications IT
description:
Position Summary

At Stony Brook Medicine, the Revenue Cycle Applications IT Director serves as a strategic leader charged with managing and enhancing the technology by supporting the organization's revenue cycle operations. This includes oversight of multi-hospital inpatient and outpatient services, physician practice registration, scheduling, health information management, and patient accounting systems.

Duties of a Director Revenue Cycle Applications IT may include the following but are not limited to\:

· Oversees the operation and continuous improvement of all IT revenue cycle systems and interfaces, including Patient Financial Services, Charge Capture and Reconciliation, Registration, Scheduling, Patient Throughput, Health Information Management, Electronic Document and Signature Capture, Visitor Management, online payment solutions, Document Imaging, Diagnostic Coding, Deficiency Management, and Enterprise Master Patient Index across multiple hospitals and physician practices.

· Leads initiatives to crosswalk data among diverse systems in support of Revenue Cycle operations.

· Manages integration and support for a comprehensive suite of revenue cycle applications.

· Directs the evaluation, selection, implementation, and upgrade of technologies designed to automate tasks, centralize processes, and drive operational efficiency.

· Analyzes data to identify trends and develop strategies aimed at optimizing revenue capture and minimizing payment denials or delays.

· Ensures compliance with healthcare regulations (e.g., HIPAA) and payer requirements and coordinates the provision of required data to regulatory bodies and partner agencies.

· Serves as a liaison between Revenue Cycle and IT departments to facilitate integration and uphold data integrity.

· Collaborate with clinical, financial, and administrative teams to streamline workflows, enhance patient experience, and optimize financial operations.

· Manages vendor and partner relationships, conducting invoice reconciliations against completed deliverables.

· Supervises teams of system administrators and analysts responsible for maintaining revenue cycle technologies and supporting related initiatives.

· Requires proficiency in project management skills for implementing assigned projects, as well as strong collaboration abilities to support the Office of the PMO on enterprise-level initiatives.

· Plans resource allocation in alignment with organizational priorities and projects.

· Delivers effective leadership and supervision for direct reports and staff, including responsibilities for staffing, professional growth, human resource management, resource allocation, training, and ensuring compliance with established standards, policies, and best practices.

· Maintains software portfolios and IT support within ancillary areas; manages inventories of relevant equipment.

· Fosters a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and collaboration.

· Leads the development of system requirements, procurement, functional specifications, implementation, performance monitoring, enhancements, workflow assessments, outcome reviews, and recommendations for process redesign.

· Partners with Revenue Cycle Departments in requirements analysis, planning, selection, budgeting, design, implementation, and ongoing support of systems aligned with organizational strategic objectives, providing expertise throughout the application system lifecycle.

· Coordinates Revenue Cycle system operations with other directors to effectively prioritize team initiatives, ensuring seamless support for end-user departments and core business processes. Actively contributes to SBMIT’s strategic and operational objectives as an integral member of the SBMIT leadership team.

· Departmental capital planning, covering application upgrades, innovation, and technical needs assessments.

· Oversight of departmental capital and operational budgets.

· Adheres to organizational security policies and guidelines.

· Develops contingency procedures for all critical Revenue Cycle Applications.

· Participates in on-call rotations as required.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications\:

· Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Finance, or Business, Information Technology or related field.

· A minimum of (8) eight years of progressive experience in healthcare revenue cycle roles within a health system, which encompasses hospitals, ambulatory services, and physician practices.

· Minimum of (3) three years’ experience in managing and leading large or impactful revenue cycle teams.

· Extensive experience in healthcare revenue cycle operations, encompassing systems expertise, patient registration and throughput, health information management, claims processing and reimbursement, payer contracts, and applicable regulations.

· Demonstrated leadership in system implementation and conversions, with advanced proficiency in revenue cycle management software.

· Demonstrated Experience with health system Revenue Cycle Applications, including the core components of Patient Registration, Scheduling, Acute Case Management, Health Information Management, Medical Coding, Eligibility, Batch Document Scanning and Patient Accounting.

· Experience with integrating Electronic Health Record Systems and Revenue Cycle Applications.

· In-depth knowledge of integrating third-party systems, including insurance eligibility verification, claim scrubbing, electronic claims submission and remittance, encoder tools, financial analytics platforms, online appointment scheduling, and touchless check-in solutions.

· Strong background in patient throughput and charge reconciliation processes.

· Experience with Electronic Master Patient Index Solutions (EMPI)

· Experience leading or developing specifications for Request for Proposal (RFP) or similar committee-scored bid procurement processes for IT projects.

· Proficient understanding of project management methodologies.

· Exceptional interpersonal, communication, leadership, and change management abilities to foster collaborative and productive working relationships.

· Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications\:

· Experience with Cerner Soarian and/or Oracle Health Patient Accounting Revenue Cycle Products

· Experience with Oracle Health Cerner Millenium Electronic Health Record

· Experience with Athena IDX Registration, Scheduling, and Billing.

· Familiarity with NYS procurement processes.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Rockstar is recruiting for a seed-stage tech startup that is building the modern operating system for global procurement. Backed by top venture investors, they have grown their customer base 5x in the past year and are now looking to scale rapidly. Their mission is to bring transparency and reliability to global supply chains. The team is seeking an early engineer to join them on the ground floor as they scale their product offering and customer base.

Overview

The company has a bold mission: bring transparency and reliability to global supply chains. They are starting by building the modern operating system for procurement, helping businesses understand their supply networks and adapt to disruption.

The company is a seed-stage tech startup backed by top venture investors. This past year, they have grown their customer base 5x, and they are looking to grow rapidly. Join the team on the ground floor as they scale their product offering and customer base.

The Founding Team

Isaac Chambers

  • 3x founder
  • Started his career at Deloitte Consulting, focusing on supply chain & manufacturing operations for the aerospace & defense sector.

Brent Shulman

  • Full-stack engineering leader
  • Previously an engineer at Palantir and Pave
  • While at Pave (where he joined as the 10th engineer), he founded, grew, and led the data integration team, scaling from 10 to thousands of customer connections.

The Opportunity

As an early engineer, you will play a critical role in setting the company’s technical direction. You will be hands-on, building the early product and talking directly with initial customers and users. From the start, it is critical that you can build a 0-1 product with great UI/UX. As the company grows, you will own and lead the architectural roadmap that will lay the foundation for the platform. Your technical leadership will be a key factor in supporting and growing the engineering and product teams.

You need to be both strategic and tactical. The company is seeking a builder to develop product specs and front-end components into an enterprise-ready application. They are also looking for a self-starter, not afraid to get their hands dirty and rapidly iterate on prototypes early in the development lifecycle. An ability to handle ambiguity is a must.

The company needs a top-tier team to help build a platform that will fundamentally change and improve supply chain networks.

Looking back on your first 12 months at the company, you will have:

  • Built and led the delivery of the early versions of the platform, spearheading pilot programs at initial customers
  • Worked with the team to think through strategy and the evolution of the business
  • Influenced new product and feature design while defining a long-term technical strategy aligned with industry best practices
  • Designed and implemented platform integrations with outside APIs, partners, and cloud infrastructure
  • Built something scrappily to show customer value, so that the team has now earned the right to re-architect for scale

What the Ideal Candidate Brings to the Company

  • 5+ years building across front-end and back-end
  • Experience with modern, open-source tech (Typescript, React, Next.js, GraphQL, Trigger.dev)
  • Startup experience and/or agency experience (bonus if it is in supply chain). Early-stage product experience building from zero to one
  • Ability to build out various API integrations with speed
  • Experience working with non-technical stakeholders and users. Comfortable leading and managing an engineering team
  • Ideal experience includes previous work with various ERP system APIs

Compensation

Compensation includes equity.

Base Salary: $150,000 – $225,000 per year

title: Senior Network Security Engineer - DGX Cloud
description:
NVIDIA is seeking a Sr Network Security Engineer to implement and maintain robust security across on-premise and cloud environments - enabling business verticals that span Graphics Drivers to AI and Deep Learning. In this role, you will lead the deployment and management of critical security infrastructure, including next-generation firewalls, load balancers, and advanced threat detection systems, safeguarding our hybrid cloud and on-premise networks while driving compliance across the organization. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in multi-cloud architectures and cybersecurity, a proven track record of supporting large-scale, high-availability networks, and hands-on experience operating with hyperscaling environments. You’re a decisive problem-solver who thrives in fast-paced settings and moves with urgency to meet the demands of modern infrastructure.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Design & Integrate: Collaborate with the network architecture team to review and comment on network designs.

  • Manage & Optimize Infrastructure: Lead the deployment, management, and troubleshooting of firewall, load balancing, and IDS/IPS solutions across both on-premise and cloud environments.

  • Enhance Visibility & Intelligence: Evolve our security feature set by using telemetry and advanced analytics to improve network observability and proactive threat detection.

  • Governance & Compliance: Define and maintain comprehensive security guidelines for on-premise and cloud deployments, ensuring consistent alignment with compliance and defense-in-depth standards.

  • Threat Mitigation: Orchestrate rigorous vulnerability management, including patching and bug scrubs, to proactively eliminate potential threat vectors.

  • IAM Strategy: Design Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies and controls specifically for services owned and operated by the global networking team.

  • Operational Excellence: Serve as a key stakeholder in security reviews and ACL approvals, ensuring safe, efficient, and resilient network operations.

  • Incident Response & Triage: Lead incident response efforts by investigating security alerts, conducting root cause analysis, and executing remediation plans in alignment with security incident handling frameworks.

  • Operational Enablement: Partner with the global operations team to ensure they have the necessary operational tools, documentation, and actionable information required to provide rapid first-response to network and security incidents.

What We Need To See:

  • Network & Cloud Security Architecture: Proven expertise in secure cloud-native and hybrid network architectures across major CSPs (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI), ensuring seamless connectivity and stringent security posture.

  • Secure Network Infrastructure: Proficiency in securely deploying and managing Fortigate (FortiManager), Arista, Cisco, and Cumulus OS devices.

  • Advanced Threat Protection: Comprehensive operational knowledge of IDS/IPS, SSL inspection, URL filtering, and anti-malware/bot mitigations to maintain high-throughput secured traffic.

  • Virtualization & Connectivity: Strong understanding of network virtualization (VRFs, VxLAN) and CSP-specific virtualized firewall deployments.

  • Dynamic Routing Protocols: Proficient in dynamic routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, IS-IS to ensure resilient and efficient network connectivity.

  • Monitoring & Observability: Experience managing logging pipelines and telemetry tools such as Splunk and Grafana for proactive security oversight.

  • Professional Experience: 8+ years of dedicated network security experience with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, coupled with the ability to collaborate cross-functionally with global security teams.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:

  • Multi-Cloud Security Expertise: Deep proficiency in OCI, GCP, AWS, and Azure cybersecurity frameworks.

  • Infrastructure Proficiency: Working knowledge of Mellanox/Cumulus OS and network routing paradigms.

  • Automation & AI-Assisted Development: Proven ability to leverage Python, Shell scripting, and AI coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to build efficient automation, frameworks, and operational dashboards.

  • Large-Scale Experience: Demonstrated success in designing and securing hyper-scale network environments.

  • Innovation Outlook: Passion for driving progress through the adoption of groundbreaking technologies.

NVIDIA is leading the way in ground breaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing and Visualization. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars.   • Je hebt actuele kennis van de Wmo en de bijbehorende wet- en regelgeving.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een betekenisvolle functie met veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid.

  • Working pattern: Flexible working, Full-time, Part-time, Compressed hours
  • Number of jobs available: 1

Location

Bootle, North West England, L20 7HS : Newport, Wales, NP10 8XG

About the job

Job summary

As a member of the Digital, Data and Technology function the post-holder will work closely with colleagues across the Commission in a multidisciplinary team and be responsible for the design of the end-to-end journey of a service. This helps a user complete their goal and the Charity Commission to deliver on its responsibilities. In this role, your work will involve the creation of, or change to, transactions, products and content across both digital and offline channels provided by the Charity Commission.

A service designer is a confident and competent designer who can develop designs based on evidence of user needs and organisational outcomes.

You will:

  • Be trusted to make good decisions
  • Recognise when to ask for further guidance and support
  • Contribute to the development of design concepts
  • Interpret evidence-based research and incorporate this into your work

Job description

Key Responsibilities

Design communication

    • Clearly explain problems and design ideas to others
    • Clearly explain design decisions to others using appropriate tools and methods

    Designing for everyone

    1. Work with others to design and deliver inclusive, accessible and environmentally sustainable content or services that meet the needs of all users
    2. Ensure a design meets appropriate standards, for example accessibility regulations, with support

    Designing strategically

    • Align your design work to both the goals and vision of your team and the strategic objectives of your organisation
    • Identify potential risks and use design to mitigate them
    • Identify opportunities and use design to take advantage of them
    • Contribute to the development of design patterns and components

    Designing together

    • Effectively plan and run a design session with your team, users or internal and external stakeholders
    • Identify and engage the right people throughout the design process
    • Give and receive constructive design feedback

    Evidence-based design

    • Analyse, synthesise and clearly explain evidence relevant to users or a service, for example, web analytics data
    • Work with researchers or analysts to use evidence to inform, develop and test a design idea

    Iterative design

    • Apply iterative design principles and agile methodologies to your work
    • Iterate and improve a design based on successive rounds of research
    • Prototype your ideas at different fidelities to explore and test designs
    • Use a range of design tools and techniques
    • Use and iterate design patterns and components

    Leading design

    • Lead and coordinate design work in your team, with support
    • Communicate the value of user-centred design to your team
    • Support other designers
    • Work with digital and data leaders in your organisation, when needed

    Problem solving

    • Draw together and present reasoned solutions based on a wide range of complex evidence and data - able to act or decide even when details are not clear.
    • Recognise patterns and trends from a wide range of evidence / data and draw key conclusions, outlining benefits, risks and design opportunities.
    • Identify the main issues in complex problems; clarify understanding or expectations to discover opportunities to create value to users and the business.
    • Influence internal and external stakeholders and senior leaders through your analysis and make use of qualitative and quantitative evidence to inform design decisions.

    Decision-making

    • Present findings and related design / business recommendations to key decision makers.
    • Work within clear criteria and timescales laid down by colleagues.
    • Plot timelines and manage your workload to suit your own capacity and the project/business need.
    • Make day to day operational decisions relating to the co-ordination of user research activity within the Commission.

    Person specification

    Essential criteria

    Ability:

    • Understanding of a range of user centred service design and delivery practices
    • Ability to understand what problem your team is trying to solve, and align design activities to inform decision making and action
    • Have an understanding of a range of service design methods, when to use those methods and how to apply them correctly
    • Ability to utilise of a range of techniques for analysis of research data, synthesis of findings, and presentation of clear findings that colleagues can understand and use
    • A good understanding of the social and technological context, , and the ability to align service design activities to help the team understand changing user behaviour
    • Ability to use research and analytics to understand user needs, identify service failures and test different designs
    • Ability to champion accessibility and inclusion, consider the impact of new technologies and make sure that designs meet accessibility, legal and security requirements
    • Able to use evidence to challenge assumptions, negotiate with product owners and rationalise design decisions based on user research and established best practices.

    Experience:

    • Proven experience of prototyping and designing for web-based services
    • Proven experience of designing and facilitating collaborative design activities
    • Proven experience within a research and digital design environment
    • Demonstrable knowledge, experience in and passion for user centred design practices for web, service and software development
    • Experience of working with colleagues to plan and do continuous design practice in a multidisciplinary team

title: Engineering Leader
description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.

The Role

You'll be a player-coach engineering leader with a spike in technical strategy, you'll own engineering delivery for your team end-to-end - from developing exceptional engineers to solving some of our most difficult engineering problems & setting technical direction.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll spend roughly 20% of your time contributing code and 80% leading your team, with that ratio shifting as we scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, hire, and develop a high-performing engineering team

  • Help set technical direction and architecture decisions

  • Work with the engineering to tackle some of our most difficult problems

  • Own engineering delivery with an emphasis on velocity

  • Collaborate closely with Product on roadmap and prioritisation

  • Write code when needed so you'll stay close to the product

The Opportunity

We are in the unique situation that our commercial traction is ahead of our product. You’ll play a leading role in moving towards automation in a way that enables us to rapidly scale with increased complexity and specific customer nuances.

About You

  • You have extensive experience in architecting enterprise-level systems, delivering on ambitious product visions, and building world class engineering teams.

  • You have worked at high-growth businesses, and might have previously started your own company.

  • You are highly analytical, and thinking proactively through the implications of your decisions, but also have high conviction and understand the importance of moving at pace and shipping often.

  • You have previously led engineering at a company from its earliest stages, and don’t shy away from the manager role - you know what great looks like, and want to help engineers grow.

Essential Experience

  • 8+ years software engineering experience

  • Track record of hiring and developing strong engineers

  • Strong production systems background - you've built and scaled things that matter, and you’ve done something hard and lived to tell the tale

  • Proven experience in distributed systems

  • Experience operating autonomously in small, high-velocity environments - ideally in a startup

  • Experience working in a data-focused company or closely alongside a data engineering/ML team - data is core to what we're building at Kernel, and you will play a key role in shaping how we grow that capability

Nice-to-Have:

  • Scaled an engineering team through a growth phase (5 → 20+ engineers), or from Series A to Series C

  • Technical depth across the stack: NodeJS, Postgres, TypeScript, Kubernetes AI-driven or data-heavy product experience

  • Understanding of LLMs (e.g., RAG, prompt engineering, evals)

  • CRM data models or workflow automation knowledge

  • Hands-on Data Engineering or ML Engineering experience - as data becomes an increasingly large part of what we do, this would be a great asset for us to have

⚠️ This role may not be for you if you:

  • Insist on shipping pixel-perfect code

  • Prefer managing from a distance without technical involvement

  • Need extensive process and structure before making decisions

❌ This role is definitely not for you:

  • If you over-rely on AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) to the point where you don’t read or understand your own code

  • If you on the other hand don’t understand how these tools (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) can be force multipliers for senior engineers if used correctly

  • If you prefer fully remote work

  • If you don’t like early-stage startup pace

  • If you’re seeking a purely ‘hands-off’ role

Tech Stack

  • Backend: AWS, NodeJS, TypeScript, Postgres, Clickhouse, Kubernetes

  • Frontend: NextJS, TypeScript, Tailwind

You don't need to know everything, but you should be comfortable diving into any part of the stack.

What We Offer

We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.

  • 💰 Salary: £130,000 – £170,000 + equity

  • 🗓️ 24 days holiday per year + bank holidays

  • 🥕 £450 Monthly Office Dinner Allowance

  • ✈️ 2 weeks work-from-anywhere

  • 🍼 Generous parental leave policy

  • 💼 Pension plan

  • 💻 Top-spec equipment and central London office

  • 🎉 Team events and dinners

  • 🚀 Work directly with the founders to scale the systems that power enterprise AI

  • 🏆 High-autonomy, high-trust environment with a small team shipping at pace

🎫 Visas & Relocation

We sponsor visas for exceptional candidates and provide relocation support for those moving to London.

Interview Process

Stage 1: Introductory Call (45 minutes)

An introductory conversation covering your professional background and what you’re looking for in your next role.

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Call (30 minutes)

A conversation with Marcus focused on ways of working and team collaboration.

Stage 3: Technical Deep Dive (60 minutes)

An in-depth discussion exploring your architectural thinking and past technical decisions.

Stage 4: Leadership Scenario Interview (60 minutes)

An onsite interview at our London office, where we’ll walk through real challenges you’d likely face in the role.

Final Stage: Founders Interview

A conversation with our co-founders, Anders and Marcus, focused on values alignment and long-term vision.

Upon mutual fit: references and offer stage.

title: Senior Technical Leader
description:
Be visionary

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.​

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

Job Description

Our Company is built on employee mutual commitment and respect, enthusiasm and progress.

Teledyne Digital Imaging Inc. is a subsidiary of Teledyne Technologies Inc., a U.S. publicly listed enterprise, and specializes in the manufacture, design, research and development of high performance CMOS and CCD image sensors and modular expandable cameras. Teledyne Digital Imaging’s products are used worldwide in machine vision, document scanning, image capture, surveillance, process monitoring, manufacturing inspection, medical imaging, and multi media.

As part of our continuing growth in this high technology market, Teledyne Digital Imaging Inc. is recruiting for a Senior Technical Leader to join our team in Waterloo !

What you’ll do

The Space & Defense group develops both full custom and semi-custom image sensors, focal plane arrays, and cameras for Airborne & Space applications. As the Technical Leader of one or more projects, you will be responsible for their overall technical success by ensuring the final product meets customer specifications, and ensuring technical risk is managed/mitigated. Working hand-in-hand with the Project Manager, you will lead a team that may include sensor/electronics/mechanical design specialists, process engineers, and test specialists. The Technical Leader must also interact with other Teledyne groups including manufacturing, purchasing, and CMOS development.

What you need

  • Broad knowledge of systems engineering, process engineering, electronics design, mechanical design, and optics

  • Understanding of semiconductor theory and CMOS image sensors

  • Must be a strong team player, as well as be able to work independently

  • Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills. Report writing is essential.

  • Understanding of Design for Manufacturability and Reliability engineering

  • Experience preparing & revising technical reports and project documents

  • A minimum of 8 years of related experience (engineering, electronics, sensors, optics, software) with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years’ experience.

  • At least 5 years of design/development experience

  • Strong, proven experience leading/managing a technical project and driving technology development

  • Proven experience working within a large multidisciplinary team and excellent communication skills are required

  • Experience evaluating risk and driving change

  • Experience providing customer with technical guidance with support from technical experts

  • Proven ability to work on multiple projects with tight deadlines

  • Eligible for Controlled Goods Security Clearance

The ideal candidate will also have:

  • Experience with ECSS and MIL standards

  • Eligible for Controlled Goods security clearance

  • Strong Technical Program Management experience

  • Proven ability to work on multiple projects with tight deadlines

  • Experience leading junior designers and test specialists

  • Experience with the Space systems

  • Experience with CCD/CMOS image sensors or cameras

What we offer

  • Opportunities to grow within a global technology leader.

  • Collaborative, supportive team culture.

  • Competitive compensation.

  • Comprehensive benefits package.

  • Learning and development programs.

Occasional travel may be expected to support new customers and product introduction.

What happens next

Apply online and our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Selected candidates will be contacted for next steps, including interviews and assessments as needed.

This position is being posted in response to an existing vacancy within our organization

Teledyne Digital Imaging does not use AI tools to assist in the Screening, Assessing and Selecting of candidates for this role.

Salary Range:

$114,200.00-$152,300.000

The anticipated salary range listed for this role is only an estimate. Actual compensation for successful candidates is carefully determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, location, local regulations (such as minimum wage), education/training, work experience, key skills, and type of position.

Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. title: Regional Security Specialist
description:
About Securitas USA

Securitas Security Services USA, Inc. is the global leader in protective services, delivering specialized guarding, advanced technology solutions, and comprehensive risk management to clients across a wide range of industries. Our mission is simple yet powerful: to help make your world a safer place. With a proud legacy of 90 years, built on trust, innovation, and international expertise, we take pride in offering security solutions that are tailored to each client’s unique needs. By combining cutting-edge technology with exceptional service, we continue to redefine what safety and security mean in today's world.

Location

Fargo, ND

Compensation

The salary range for this role is from $78,000 to $82,000 annually. Securitas also offers a full benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
  • 10 accrued vacation days, 4 floating holidays, and 6 sick days
  • 401(k)

The compensation range may vary based on factors such as geographic location, relevant experience, and applicable skills.

What You’ll Do

As a Regional Security Specialist (Regional Account Manager), you will be responsible for the seamless management of guard service operations and security-related functions for a key client based in Fargo, ND. You will foster client satisfaction, resolve conflicts, and oversee operational aspects including scheduling, staffing, billing, training, and compliance. You will often operate independently in the field, making decisions that protect both the client and Securitas, while recognizing when issues need to be escalated.

Role purpose:
This position plays a key role in supporting client operations in Fargo, ND by leading day-to-day security service delivery, ensuring service quality and compliance, and managing financial and operational performance. The ideal candidate is a hands-on security leader with strong business acumen, who builds trusted client relationships, maintains strong situational awareness of frontline operations, and drives continuous improvement across the account.

Strategic Leadership & Client Relations

  • Exemplify Securitas’ core values of integrity, vigilance, and helpfulness.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for the client, ensuring high-quality services and client satisfaction.
  • Make independent, informed decisions in the field, while recognizing when issues require escalation to the Global Program Director or other leaders.
  • Collaborate with the Global Program Director (GPD) to align local operations with global security objectives and initiatives.

Service Quality, Training & Compliance

  • Continuously assess service quality and proactively address issues before they impact the client.
  • Maintain strong situational awareness of what is happening with teams on the ground and use those insights to anticipate issues and adjust operations.
  • Develop and implement training programs for security staff.
  • Ensure compliance with client requirements, company policies, and applicable regulations.
  • Establish, track, and maintain performance metrics and KPIs to measure service delivery.

Global Coordination & Networking

  • Work closely with the GPD to support global program standards and initiatives.
  • Identify and leverage networking opportunities to standardize processes and service delivery across locations.

Team Development & Operational Management

  • Oversee staff development, providing regular feedback, coaching, and performance management.
  • Ensure proper scheduling and staffing to meet service requirements and cost efficiencies.
  • Maintain close awareness of frontline operations and personnel, using on-the-ground insights to drive improvements.
  • Administer resolutions to employee issues and apply discipline as needed, in line with company policy.

Financial Management & Operational Oversight

  • Manage invoice and payment processes, including monitoring expenditures.
  • Collaborate on policy and procedure development and implementation for the account.
  • Monitor client credits and make adjustments as necessary to maintain accurate billing and financial performance.

Communication & Reporting

  • Maintain ongoing communication with the client, internal stakeholders, and the GPD.
  • Prepare, develop, and deliver dynamic Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to the client and leadership.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by the Global Program Director.

Who You Are

An ideal candidate brings a service-first mindset, clear communication skills, strong attention to detail, and sound judgment when approaching challenges. You operate independently in the field, know when and how to escalate issues, and make decisions that protect both the client and Securitas. You maintain strong situational awareness of what is happening with the teams on the ground and can balance client expectations, operational realities, and financial performance in a fast-paced environment. You are comfortable working within an ordered set of procedures and processes, and you respect a clear chain of command.

Education / Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in security industry-related fields or business management.
  • At least 3+ years of direct supervisory or management experience.
  • Law enforcement, military, or public safety experience preferred.

Technical or Job-Specific Skills

  • Strong security and business management experience.
  • In-depth knowledge of security operations and procedures.
  • Excellent planning and organizational skills.
  • Strong financial experience, including budget planning and forecasting.
  • Ability to interpret, track, and maintain schedules, metrics, and performance indicators.
  • Proficiency with computer systems, particularly Microsoft Office and data visualization tools.

Skills & Competencies

  • Ability to operate independently with limited day-to-day direction, while staying aligned with program goals and standards.
  • Strong judgment on when to escalate issues to the Global Program Director or other stakeholders.
  • Proven decision-making skills that prioritize safety, reliability, and risk mitigation for both the client and Securitas.
  • High level of situational awareness regarding field operations and frontline personnel.
  • Comfort working within an ordered set of procedures and processes, including a clear chain of command.
  • Strong team collaboration and client-centric mindset.
  • Ability to maintain composure and professionalism in unusual or high-pressure circumstances.
  • Adaptability to rapidly changing environments or assignments.
  • Clear, professional communication skills, both written and verbal.

Experience That Sets You Apart

  • Prior experience managing guard services or contract security operations.
  • Experience working within a global or multi-site client program.
  • Law enforcement, military, or public safety experience, especially roles that required following structured procedures, clear chain of command, and disciplined decision-making.
  • Additional certifications in security management or related fields.
  • Industry knowledge of best practices in corporate security and risk management.

Why You Would Want to Join the Team

  • Opportunity to make a direct impact on a key client’s security operations and overall safety.
  • Exposure to executive leadership, the Global Program Director, and key client stakeholders.
  • Career growth and development opportunities within Securitas’ global organization.
  • Collaborative team culture with strong leadership support and a performance-driven environment.
  • Chance to work with modern tools, metrics, and reporting to drive continuous improvement.
  • Be part of a company whose mission is to help make the world a safer place.

title: Director of Brand & Thought Leadership
description:
We’re looking for a Director of Brand & Thought Leadership to build and govern the group´s brand architecture, spanning our portfolio brands Cookie Information, Piwik PRO and Sheltr, so that a distinctive, consistent brand drives reputation, thought leadership and commercial value across all markets.


Reporting to the CCO, you will play a key role in shaping how our brands are positioned, perceived and experienced. You will lead brand strategy, communications and thought leadership across the portfolio, influence commercial investment decisions, and build the team and capabilities needed to support our next stage of growth.


We are open to on-site, hybrid, and remote working within two time zones of our offices (CET).

In this role, please expect to travel up to 40% of the time.



About Us


Our group brings together three European software brands that help organisations earn and use data with trust: Cookie Information for consent management; Piwik PRO for privacy-by-design analytics and data activation; and Sheltr for reliably finding personal data in internal data sources.


Headquartered in Copenhagen with an office in Wrocław, our team of 180 people have been building trusted data solutions since 2011. We work with companies and marketing teams across various industries that take control of their data model, including some of the most data-sensitive clients in healthcare, finance, energy & utilities, and the public sector. We are proud that our clients rely on us to meet GDPR and EU data residency requirements across EMEA and the US, as this regulatory depth is hard to build and replicate. We believe compliance and performance are not opposites. Consented data, auditable analytics and full visibility of personal data belong to one data journey; together they form a foundation that marketing, IT, legal and the C-level can rely on.


Our journey is to move from a regulation-driven house of brands to one unified company with a clear point of view. We are creating a new category around this complete data journey, and together we are building an enterprise-ready, data-driven revenue engine led by thought leadership. Want to join us on this journey? Keep reading to find out how you can help shape this with us.



The Role


As Director, you will own the strategic direction of our brand portfolio, balancing a coherent group identity with distinct positioning for each product brand. You will connect brand strategy to commercial objectives, lead a multidisciplinary team and work closely with senior leadership to build long-term brand value.


Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Owning and evolving a coherent brand strategy and architecture across all three brands, ensuring clear positioning, differentiation and consistent brand experiences.
  • Connecting brand investments to business objectives, setting priorities and success measures, and informing strategic decisions alongside the CCO and CEO.
  • Owning brand health tracking and the annual brand review, translating research and market insights into strategic recommendations.
  • Leading the portfolio's PR, content, events, community and digital presence to strengthen market visibility, credibility and category leadership.
  • Leading and developing a multidisciplinary team, align cross-functional stakeholders, and manage external agencies and strategic partners.



About you


You are an experienced brand leader who combines strategic thinking, commercial acumen and strong leadership skills. You know how to build distinctive brands, influence stakeholders and translate strategy into measurable business impact.


You bring:

  • Significant experience in brand strategy, brand management, communications and PR leadership.
  • A track record of leading brand transformation, repositioning or portfolio development.
  • Experience leading hybrid-working teams and managing complex stakeholder relationships.
  • Strong commercial understanding and the ability to connect brand investment to business priorities.
  • Experience using market research and brand health metrics to guide strategic decisions.
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in English (C2).


Nice-to-haves:

  • B2B SaaS, technology, data, privacy or analytics experience.
  • Multi-brand portfolio, brand architecture or category creation experience.
  • Experience with quantitative and qualitative research methods.
  • Knowledge of GDPR and privacy-regulated markets.
  • Fluency in German, French or a Nordic language.



What we offer

  • A unique opportunity to shape a brand portfolio. Lead the development of a new umbrella brand alongside three established product brands.
  • Build a team, shape our brand direction and make a lasting impact across the business.
  • You’ll work closely with the CCO and CEO and influence strategic and commercial decisions.
  • Help shape the story of privacy-first data and its role in the European market.
  • Professional development budget, health insurance, and other benefits.
  • A positive, informal workplace.



Application process


We’re looking to fill the position as soon as possible and will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to send your application today.


This is what our recruitment process looks like:

  • A brief screening call with our Talent Partner (online, approx. 30 mins)
  • An in-depth interview with the hiring manager and a member of the team
  • Interview with a key stakeholder including a live case
  • A final interview with our CCO


This process is subject to change. All applicants who progress to the screening call will be informed of the full process as some stages may be combined and/or in person.



Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion


At Cookie Information & Piwik PRO we value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We recognise that certain groups are underrepresented in the tech industry, and we encourage everyone to apply and help us shape a more inclusive workspace.

title: Director, Web Growth
description:
About Us:
Live experiences help people cross today’s digital divide and focus on what truly connects us – the here, the now, this once-in-a-lifetime moment that’s bringing us together. To fulfill Gametime’s mission of uniting the world through shared experiences, we make it easy for people to discover and access the live experiences that matter most.
With platforms on iOS, Android, mobile web and desktop supporting more than 60,000 events across the US and Canada, we are reimagining the event ticket industry in order to move at the speed of life.

The Role

Mobile has long been at the center of Gametime's success, but web GMV potential isn't fully realized. Today, the levers that drive it — paid search, on-site conversion, SEO, and content — are managed in pieces rather than owned as a single outcome.

We're hiring a Director of Web Growth to change that: to run web the way a GM runs a business, with GMV as the number you're accountable for and every channel and page as a lever you're willing to pull, cut, or reinvent to move it. You'll identify where growth is being left on the table, prioritize the highest-impact opportunities, and partner closely with Product and Engineering to unlock them — not just request changes, but diagnose funnel drop-off yourself and drive the fixes.

This is a new role. You'll manage our paid search function directly, work hands-on with Product on conversion and funnel performance, and stand up net-new capability in SEO and content — likely starting with contractors and agencies rather than a large owned team. You'll report to the VP of Growth, alongside peers running paid social, CRM/lifecycle, and offline/brand media.

What You'll Own

  • Web-driven GMV and blended contribution economics as your core metric — not the performance of any single channel in isolation.
  • Own the comprehensive view of a web customer’s total lifecycle, defining and strengthening the funnel to drive customer lifetime value.
  • Direct management of our paid search team — strategy, budget allocation, and performance, with enough SEM fluency to coach and push, not necessarily to execute it yourself.
  • Hands-on partnership with Product on CRO — analyzing funnel performance and customer behavior, prioritizing a testing roadmap, and pushing site/experience changes that move conversion, not just requesting them.
  • An experimentation engine — establishing a rigorous testing culture across landing pages, user flows, and conversion optimization, in partnership with Product and Engineering.
  • Building SEO and content capability from the ground up — scoping the opportunity, deciding whether it's an agency, contractor, or eventual hire, and standing up the initial engine.
  • Cross-functional input into paid social and CRM where it intersects with the web funnel or GMV mix, without formal ownership of that channel.
  • A clear, data-grounded point of view on when web should feed app installs versus stand on its own, with tradeoffs made explicit to leadership.
  • Full-funnel economics — blended CAC/LTV, contribution margin, AOV — as the language you use to defend tradeoffs, not channel-level vanity metrics.
  • Visibility and operating cadence — building the dashboards, metrics, and business reviews that keep web growth focused on the highest-impact opportunities.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 8–12 years in growth, web product, ecommerce, or CRO, including 2–3+ years owning a revenue or GMV number that spanned more than one channel.
  • Strong web product sense: you can look at a funnel, form a hypothesis about what's broken, and work with Product/Design/Engineering to test and fix it yourself — this is the core muscle of the role.
  • Working fluency in paid search — you understand SEM well enough to direct strategy, coach a team, and ask sharp questions, even if you're not the one in the platform day to day.
  • Fluency in full-funnel economics — blended CAC/LTV, contribution margin, AOV — as the language you use to make and defend decisions.
  • Experience standing up new capability (a channel, a team, a vendor relationship) from a lean or zero starting point.
  • A track record of being evaluated on a business outcome rather than a channel KPI.

Bonus

  • Background at a marketplace, travel, ecommerce, or inventory/demand-driven business where SEM, SEO, and CRO had to work together against one number.
  • Experience managing SEO and/or content through agencies or contractors rather than solely through an owned team.
  • A point of view on web-to-app dynamics in a company with both surfaces.
  • Formal experimentation program design (prioritization frameworks, testing governance).
  • Pricing or promo strategy exposure.
  • AI fluency — using AI to accelerate experimentation, testing velocity, or decision-making.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days

  • You've audited the web funnel and SEM program, identified the biggest efficiency gaps and growth levers, and have a documented point of view on where to focus.
  • You're managing the paid search team independently and have a clear handle on account structure, budget, and performance.
  • You've scoped the SEO/content opportunity and have a plan — agency, contractor, or otherwise — to start building it.

In your first year

  • Web-driven GMV is growing efficiently, and you can point to specific tradeoffs you made across channels to get there.
  • You've run meaningful CRO/experimentation work in partnership with Product that measurably improved conversion.
  • SEO/content capability exists where there was none, and is producing early signal.
  • You have a clear, evidence-based point of view on the web/app relationship that leadership trusts.

The Team

You'll join a small, experienced growth team and report to the VP of Growth, alongside peers running paid social, CRM/lifecycle, and offline media. This is a player-coach role, weighted toward player — you'll manage the paid search team directly, but the CRO and SEO/content work is hands-on. You're building capability more than inheriting it.

What We Can Offer

  • Flexible PTO
  • Competitive salary & equity package
  • Monthly Gametime credits for any event ($1,200/yr)
  • Medical, dental, & vision insurance
  • Life insurance and disability benefits
  • Diverse Family-forming benefits through Carrot Fertility
  • 401k, HSA, pre-tax savings programs
  • Company off-sites and meet-ups
  • Wellness programs
  • Tenure recognition

The Ecosystems Analysis Team helps JNCC’s stakeholders meet the challenges of managing our environment and the benefits it provides.
This dynamic, multi-disciplinary team brings together three elements:

  • A set of long-term partnerships with organisations undertaking species surveys in terrestrial, coastal and freshwater ecosystems using networks of volunteers
  • An analysis and modelling capability producing rapidly deployable models. These include a range of models focussed on predicting outcomes from changing land uses and environmental pressures
  • An Earth observation (EO) data processing and analytical capability with expertise in using EO to provide high-quality evidence on biodiversity and ecosystems to inform environmental decision making

As an EO Specialist, you will help JNCC deploy habitat and feature mapping methods, develop products to detect change in habitat condition or management, and provide biophysical parameters for environmental modelling. The post would contribute to projects across the work of the team, and to projects led by other teams in JNCC, bringing technical evidence skills and insight into integrating evidence on habitat extent and condition.

The post will focus on EO data analyses but will also work collaboratively with other analytical, data science and data infrastructure skills across the Ecosystems Analysis and Digital and Data Solutions Teams. Recent examples of EO applications developed by the team and our partners include national-scale habitat extent and change mapping, coastal habitat monitoring in a changing climate, developing indicators of urban blue and green space extent and type, and developing national indicators of woodland condition and young tree health. Whilst much of the work of the team is terrestrial, some work on marine environments is possible.

Job description

Post Duties:

The post will be managed by a Senior Earth Observation Specialist, and you will work with other EO specialists, as well as modellers, analysts, and surveillance experts. The main duties of the post are to:

  • Carry out a variety of analyses where EO is needed as a significant input, working with JNCC colleagues with other technical or stakeholder-facing skills where appropriate
    o Analysis will include developing new methods and adapting existing ones to analyse EO and other geospatial data.
    o Extracting methods from EO research that can be deployed practically to help ensure EO data from a range of sensors can make a greater contribution to environmental applications
  • Provide expert advice on suitability of analytical methods and appropriate use of EO data to aid delivery of programmes led by key stakeholders and other teams within JNCC, notably International, Marine and Digital and Data Solutions
  • Contribute to the development and running of data management systems that will enable JNCC to provide EO based outputs over large geographic scales within the UK and elsewhere
  • Collate and assess information from stakeholders to help identify their evidence needs and where EO approaches can provide effective solutions
  • Manage work packages for the team or other teams in JNCC, focusing on projects that will require some EO analytical components, ensuring that staff resources are used effectively and that we work efficiently alongside external contractors
  • Manage data effectively to JNCC standards and ensure effective quality control and quality assurance is carried out for analytical methods and products

The post-holder may be required to attend meetings and other fora at various localities in the UK and potentially internationally, involving overnight stays away from home.

Person specification

In the event that we receive a large volume of applications, we reserve the right to conduct the sift based on the lead Technical criteria (A strong understanding of Earth Observation data and underlying principles, including familiarity with data from a range of sensors and platforms, alongside experience in applying recognised EO modelling and classification approaches).

  • Communicating and Influencing

We only ask for evidence of these behaviours on your application form:

We'll assess you against these technical skills during the selection process:

  • A strong understanding of Earth Observation data and underlying principles, including familiarity with data from a range of sensors and platforms, alongside experience in applying recognised EO modelling and classification approaches
  • Experience of applying EO techniques in the context of environmental applications, ideally related to land cover and habitat assessment (desirable)
  • Be confident in manipulating and analysing EO and geospatial data, including experience of using GIS, as well as scripting/programming (preferably Python or R), particularly for automating processes
  • Be confident in communicating complex concepts to non-technical audiences

We only ask for evidence of these technical skills on your application form:

  • Experience of applying EO techniques in the context of environmental applications, ideally related to land cover and habitat assessment (desirable)
