description:
Who are we?


At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.

We’re looking for an Expert Observability Engineer with deep expertise in Grafana Cloud to help shape and scale our enterprise observability capabilities.

This is more than a dashboard-building role. We’re looking for someone who understands observability as an engineering capability, combining deep technical expertise with architecture, automation, SRE practices, governance, and the ability to influence engineering teams.

Responsibilities & Deliverables

  • Architect and scale Grafana Cloud across a complex enterprise environment
  • Design observability patterns across metrics, logs, traces, alerting, dashboards, and synthetic monitoring
  • Drive OpenTelemetry instrumentation and adoption
  • Build reusable onboarding patterns and automation using Terraform, APIs, Git, and CI/CD
  • Define scalable approaches to RBAC/LBAC, tenancy, ownership, tagging, and governance
  • Help teams establish SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and service-health practices
  • Improve alert quality and integration with incident-management processes
  • Optimize telemetry consumption and observability costs
  • Mentor engineers and help drive observability maturity across product and platform teams

Required Qualifications

  • Grafana / Grafana Cloud
  • OpenTelemetry
  • Metrics, logs and distributed tracing
  • Prometheus and Loki concepts
  • Kubernetes, microservices and cloud-native environments
  • Terraform / Infrastructure as Code
  • SRE practices, SLIs/SLOs and service health
  • Observability architecture and platform governance
  • Automation, APIs, Git and CI/CD

Compensation: 112 - 130k

We are proud to offer a range of incentives to our employees worldwide. These benefits are available to everyone, regardless of grade, and reflect the values we stand for:

Flexibility: Enjoy unlimited vacation, subject to local regulations and business priorities. Benefit from hybrid working arrangements and inclusive policies such as paid time off for voting, bereavement, and sick leave.

Well‑being: Access confidential one‑to‑one support through our Employee Assistance Program, connect with our network of Wellbeing Champions and Gather Groups, and take part in monthly events and initiatives designed to help you thrive—inside and outside of work.

Health & Financial Security: Medical, life and disability insurance, retirement plans, lifestyle, and other benefits.*

Sustainability: Paid time off for volunteering and donation‑matching opportunities to support causes that matter to you.

Inclusion: Get involved in our inclusion communities, such as Count Me In, Culture@Finastra, Proud@Finastra, Disabilities@Finastra, and Women@Finastra—open to everyone who wants to participate and contribute.

Career Development: Access online learning and accredited courses through our Skills & Career Navigator tool.

Recognition: Take part in our global recognition program, Finastra Celebrates, and share your voice through regular employee surveys that help shape our culture and ways of working.

*Specific benefits may vary by location.

At Finastra, each individual is unique—bringing their own ideas, perspectives, cultural backgrounds, and experiences. We learn from one another, value what makes us different, and create an environment where everyone feels included, supported, and able to be their authentic selves.

Be unique. Be exceptional. Help us make a difference at Finastra.

Finastra is committed to providing accessible employment practices that are in compliance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). We will accommodate applicants' needs upon request, throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Please inform us of the accommodation(s) that you may require. Information received related to accommodation will be addressed confidentially.

title: FCBank, Universal Associate, Full time
description:
Universal Associates are hardworking, self-motivated individuals with positive attitudes who provide a specialized banking experience and are empowered to recommend solutions for individual client’s needs. Universal Associates follow our bank philosophy: Positive Energy, Positive Outcomes.

Below is a list of essential functions of this position. Additional responsibilities may be assigned in the position.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Enthusiastically greet our clients and engage in conversations. Uncover opportunities and make product and service recommendations.
  • Deliver an exceptional experience to our clients by creating an unforgettable banking experience with every interaction.
  • Perform accurate transactions, maintenance for clients, account opening and retail lending at a high level.
  • Follow all bank policies and operational procedures to ensure security and compliance.
  • Meet or exceed performance targets related to customer satisfaction, product sales, and financial wellness conversations.

ATTITUDES

Builds positive relationships with internal and external clients by valuing other's feelings and rights in both words and actions, and embracing other's unique beliefs, backgrounds, and perspectives by demonstrating:

  • Respect- treat every client and colleague with dignity and respect.
  • Client Focus- greet customers warmly, listen attentively and provide tailored financial solutions.
  • Inclusion- embrace diverse perspectives creating a welcoming environment for all.

BEHAVIORS

Demonstrates strong business ethics and honest behaviors and the ability to positively influence and work with others to achieve excellent results by demonstrating:

  • Leadership- show leadership in day-to-day operations by modeling a positive attitude and strong work ethic.
  • Integrity- adheres to bank policies, arrives on time, takes responsibilities for their actions and contributes to a positive, trustworthy atmosphere that reflects the bank’s standards and values.
  • Collaboration- work effectively within a team, contribute ideas, and support colleagues.
  • Volunteerism- actively support and participate in community outreach and volunteer initiatives.

COMPETENCIES

Reflects skill, good judgement, positive conduct, and personal responsibility for assigned areas. Seeks to implement and leverage services and technologies that create efficiencies by demonstrating:

  • Accountability- accurately process transactions in compliance with bank policies and regulatory standards. Effectively manage cash drawer, TCD, TCR, ETM, Vault and coin machine responsibilities. Take ownership of daily job duties.
  • Innovation- identify opportunities to improve service efficiency or customer experience and suggest creative solutions.
  • Professionalism- consistently demonstrates courteous behavior, integrity, and a strong work ethic while representing the bank with a polished appearance and clear communication.

POSITION LEVEL(S) EXPECTATIONS (if applicable)

  • UA I- Open consumer and business deposit accounts
  • UA II- Ability to uncover and originate consumer loans plus all above duties.
  • UA III- Maintain current registration with NMLS to originate home equity loans and lines. Uncover and build upon Center of Influence and Networking Opportunities plus all above duties.
  • UA IV- Maintain current registration with NMLS to originate purchase mortgages plus all above duties.

SEEKS PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT OPPORTUNITIES

Actively participate in expanding skill sets and career paths by attending training programs, workshops, certifications, and educational resources relevant to the role. Set stretch assignments and cross functional opportunities that foster growth and learning.

title: Shift Lead - Wolt Market Attica
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Έχεις αποκτήσει εμπειρία στις λειτουργίες των Wolt Markets και θέλεις να κάνεις το επόμενο βήμα στην καριέρα σου; Σου αρέσει να υποστηρίζεις την ομάδα σου, να βελτιώνεις διαδικασίες και να συμβάλλεις στην επίτευξη υψηλών προτύπων λειτουργίας και εξυπηρέτησης; Τότε θα χαρούμε να σε γνωρίσουμε! 🤩

Αναζητούμε έναν Υποδιευθυντή για την ομάδα Store Operations (Grocery) στα Wolt Markets στα Νότια Προάστια.

Τι θα κάνεις

Ως Shift Lead/Assistant Store Manager, θα συνεργάζεσαι στενά με τον/την Store Manager για τη διασφάλιση της ομαλής και αποδοτικής λειτουργίας του καταστήματος. Συγκεκριμένα, θα:

  • Υποστηρίζεις την επίτευξη των καθημερινών KPIs του καταστήματος
  • Αναλαμβάνεις ενεργό ρόλο στη διαχείριση της καθημερινής λειτουργίας και λειτουργείς ως υπεύθυνος/η καταστήματος κατά την απουσία του/της Store Manager
  • Υποστηρίζεις την ομάδα στην επίλυση λειτουργικών ζητημάτων και στην αντιμετώπιση προκλήσεων της καθημερινότητας
  • Παρακολουθείς τον φόρτο εργασίας, διασφαλίζοντας την αποτελεσματική κατανομή καθηκόντων και πόρων
  • Παρέχεις και συλλέγεις feedback, συμβάλλοντας στην ανάπτυξη και δέσμευση της ομάδας
  • Συμμετέχεις ενεργά στη βελτίωση διαδικασιών και στην υλοποίηση νέων πρωτοβουλιών
  • Ηγείσαι και υποστηρίζεις μια ομάδα περίπου 20 ατόμων, ενισχύοντας μια κουλτούρα συνεργασίας, απόδοσης και συνεχούς εξέλιξης

Τι αναζητούμε

  • Προϋπηρεσία σε περιβάλλον παντοπωλείου/λιανικής ή/και εμπειρία σε λειτουργίες Wolt Market
  • Προηγούμενη εμπειρία σε ρόλο Shift Lead, Team Lead ή άλλη θέση με ευθύνες συντονισμού ομάδας θα θεωρηθεί ισχυρό πλεονέκτημα
  • Ικανότητα διαχείρισης πολλαπλών προτεραιοτήτων σε ένα δυναμικό περιβάλλον
  • Ισχυρό προσανατολισμό στην εξυπηρέτηση και στη δημιουργία θετικής εμπειρίας για πελάτες και συναδέλφους
  • Πολύ καλές επικοινωνιακές και οργανωτικές δεξιότητες
  • Καλή γνώση της αγγλικής γλώσσας
  • Διαθεσιμότητα για εργασία σε κυλιόμενες βάρδιες, συμπεριλαμβανομένων πρωινών, απογευματινών, Σαββατοκύριακων και αργιών

Χρήσιμες πληροφορίες

📍 Η εργασία πραγματοποιείται αποκλειστικά δια ζώσης στα καταστήματα Wolt Market.

📅 Τα καταστήματά μας λειτουργούν 365 ημέρες τον χρόνο, με κυλιόμενες βάρδιες μεταξύ 07:00 και 00:00 (ή έως 03:00 σε συγκεκριμένες τοποθεσίες).

Για τον λόγο αυτό, είναι σημαντικό να υπάρχει ευελιξία στη διαθεσιμότητα για πρωινές, απογευματινές και βραδινές βάρδιες, καθώς και για εργασία τα Σαββατοκύριακα και τις αργίες.

Γιατί να κάνεις αίτηση

Αυτή είναι μια εξαιρετική ευκαιρία να αναπτύξεις περαιτέρω τις ηγετικές σου δεξιότητες, να αναλάβεις αυξημένες ευθύνες και να συμβάλλεις ενεργά στην επιτυχία των Wolt Markets.

Εάν πιστεύεις ότι είσαι έτοιμος/η για το επόμενο βήμα στην επαγγελματική σου πορεία στη Wolt, θα χαρούμε να λάβουμε την αίτησή σου.

Παρακαλούμε επισύναψε το ενημερωμένο CV σου και οποιαδήποτε σχετική πληροφορία που αναδεικνύει την εμπειρία και τα επιτεύγματά σου.

Οι αιτήσεις θα αξιολογούνται σε συνεχή βάση.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Artist Lead (Account & Project Lead)
description:
ABOUT AVANT ARTE

Avant Arte is a curated platform connecting the world’s leading artists and public arts institutions with a new generation of enthusiasts, collectors and patrons. We collaborate with the most exciting contemporary artists such as Ai Weiwei, Mickalene Thomas, Maurizio Cattelan and Jenny Holzer to create limited editions of the highest quality, from prints and sculptures to digital works.

Our global community of over 4 million collectors and art enthusiasts reflects the growing energy and curiosity of a new generation transforming how art is discovered and supported. Together with leading museums and institutions, we develop fundraising collaborations that strengthen public access to art and engage the new generation of patrons who will shape its future. Make-Ready, our North London print studio, is the largest fine art silkscreen printmaker in the world.

Our mission is to make discovering and collecting art more accessible, connecting artists, institutions and audiences in meaningful ways that expand art’s reach and impact.

OUR CULTURE

We’re a small team with really big ambitions, both for what we want to achieve and also the environment we’re building. We want to create a company that remains thoughtful as we scale and tries to be genuinely progressive in how we operate. We want people to really own what they do and be given the autonomy and freedom to make mistakes, learn, and create something meaningful.

We all work incredibly hard because we really care about what Avant Arte is here to do – we’re looking for exceptional people who are proactive, hungry to learn, and want to put their pride in our collective achievements.

We know that creating an inclusive environment that promotes and values diversity is critical if we want to build something with impact and meaning. We believe that having diversity in age, background, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and perspective will make us an infinitely better company. We were shortlisted for Women in Tech’s Best Employer - Small Company and Best Benefits, and Otta’s top 100 startups to work at.

SUMMARY

An Artist Lead is personable and marketing-savvy, with the organisation skills and ability to work across multiple teams in the business. Reporting into the Head of Artist team, this role puts the Artist Lead in charge of Avant Arte’s important artist relationships.

CORE ROLE ELEMENTS

The role has three main areas of focus:


  1. ARTIST RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT (ARM)

    1. Account management & artist engagement

  • To act as a primary contact for a roster of artists, building strong, trusted relationships that maximise engagement, streamline project execution and create long-term value for both the artists and the business. Key responsibilities include;

  • Proactively manage all your accounts, ensuring consistent communication and smooth delivery

  • Building meaningful relationships with artists, their studio managers and galleries.

  • Gain a deep understanding of each artist’s ambitions - market positioning, career trajectory, and long-term legacy to shape how we collaborate effectively

  • Drive engagement in content, promotion, collector referrals and project deliveries

  • Become an expert in each artist’s market and practice, combining relationship skills with analysis of demand dynamics and sharing insights internally.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to advocate for artist needs while balancing business priorities.

  • Strengthen relationships through studio visits, introductions, profile-building opportunities beyond individual projects

  1. PROJECT MANAGEMENT

    1. Project management and delivery

  • End to end ownership of all projects, ensuring they meet all project milestones and deadlines and are delivered with an exceptional artist experience.

    • Strategy - working closely with the Marketing, Creative Production and Sales team to develop long term strategy and release plans for our top artists - spotting opportunities to grow an artist’s reputation, collector base and commercial value

  • Pricing research/ project scope - ensuring all project ideas are data-based, properly researched and the most commercially viable and exciting project with the artist

  • Contracts / agreements - working with the legal team to draw up the ‘artist agreement contract’, sharing with an artist to sign at the start of a project before going into production

  • Artist facing budgets - sharing full breakdowns with artists, including production costs and profit scenarios, with a break-even point clearly identified before going into production.

  • Cross team project management - ensuring all projects are moving at pace and being delivered to high standards with the setting up of project trackers, liaising with Marketing & Content team for specific content requests for the artist, ensuring Production is on track with CPs - implementing meeting cadences with artists and galleries/studios.

  • Comms plans - developed with Marketing & Content team and shared with artists before launch

  • Sales check-ins - check-ins provided to the artist 4 weeks before launch, with another update provided 7 days before launch.

  • Artist breakdowns - making sure these are shared with artists within 24 hours of release, and paid ASAP.

  • Post launch phase - preparing the artists editions roadmap (future project planning), internal and external retrospectives and post launch report within 7 days of launch. Development and presentation to artists and their studios of the post launch report as well as editions roadmap ideas.

  1. Pitching

  • Delivering pitches for new projects

    • Commercially successful concept reviews

      • Leading and coordinating pricing research, concept reviews and documentation, pulling in input from Creative Production and Sales along with audience and commercial market analysis to inform effective pricing and edition sizing recommendations. During the pitch reviews, you will lead the discussion and oversee the outcome (actions and next steps).

    • Winning pitches

      • Leading pitch deck creation & meetings and pulling in input from the broader team as required.

    • Reporting, tracking and learning

      • Reporting against your pitch targets on a weekly and quarterly basis by keeping pitch trackers up to date in Airtable with status and accurate projected revenue - making sure we understand what’s working and what’s not, so we can iterate our approach as we go.

KEY SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Operational & Project Management: Exceptionally organised with experience running efficient projects, delivered to budget and on time.

  • Account management: combining relationship management (building trust, communication, and long-term loyalty) with strategic, forward thinking planning for an artist’s long-term editions programme with Avant Arte.

  • High quality execution at pace and with attention to detail: Demonstrated ability to use analytical thinking and data insights to evaluate the Artist Team’s performance—both historically and in planning for the future. Capable of reading and interpreting artist market data from auction records and other relevant sources.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Able to work with a wide range of stakeholders across different functions. You’re approachable and confident.

  • Strong Communication: Comfortable simplifying complex topics, communicating clearly across audiences and writing with clarity and tone.

  • Commercial Awareness: Confident working with numbers, commercial models and performance tracking to inform artist-facing decisions.

  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Resourceful and pragmatic—able to identify challenges early and help unblock issues quickly.

DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE

  • 7+ years in a project management or account management (experience in a high-growth or creative environment is a plus)

  • Comfortable with project management and account management tooling (such as AirTable, Wrike), as well as understanding operational ways of working

  • Background or strong interest in contemporary art, artist management or cultural production

BENEFITS INCLUDE:

  • Salary range of approximately £60-75k dependent on experience (we acknowledge this is a broad range but we are open to a broad range of experience)

  • Generous equity allowance

  • Private Healthcare (UK)

  • Enhanced pension contributions and parental leave policies

  • 25 days of holiday plus four extra company wide days

  • L&D budget of €1000 per year per employee

  • Regular company socials

  • Art loan scheme for employees

title: Repair Technician, I Various day shift hours
description:
Overview:

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.

You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

What We're Looking For:

Under minimal supervision, perform basic functionality tests/troubleshooting to meet acceptable repair specifications. Use established procedures and work instructions to meet production goals and troubleshoot electronic modules. Will be required to collect data for evaluation purposes.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Performs setup, testing and modular level repair to whole units.
  • Maintains accurate record keeping for individual repairs.
  • Uses custom software testing suites to diagnose/validate hardware failure.
  • Recognizes failures, follows engineering changes, and determines appropriate action.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

  • Minimum Education: High school diploma or GED preferred but not required

Key Skills and Competencies

  • General math skills

  • Some knowledge of computers and test equipment is required.
  • Manual dexterity and visual coordination are required.

title: Customer Policy Analyst
location: Birmingham (B5 4UA) or London (E14 4HD) based with hybrid working
description:
• Job grade: Other
  • Contract type: Permanent, Loan, Secondment
  • Length of employment: This is a permanent appointment. However, we will consider loans and secondments up until 31 December 2027.
  • Business area: OFWAT - Casework, Enforcement and Customers - Customer Policy Team
  • Type of role: Analytical, Policy, Other
  • Working pattern: Flexible working, Full-time, Job share, Part-time
  • Number of jobs available: 1

Location

Birmingham (B5 4UA) or London (E14 4HD) based with hybrid working

About the job

Job summary

We are Ofwat, the Water Services Regulation Authority, a non-ministerial government department responsible for regulating the water sector in England and Wales.

We have an opportunity for a Customer Policy Analyst to join our Customer Policy Team within Casework, Enforcement & Customers Directorate.

The water sector is entering a new chapter. The government has set out a bold new direction, bringing together expertise from across the sector to deliver better outcomes for customers and the environment. We are collaborating with fellow regulators to respond to recommendations in The Independent Water Commission Report, the Welsh Government’s response to the Green Paper, Shaping the Future of Water Governance in Wales, and the Government’s White Paper, A new vision for water.

Ofwat is working with the government and other regulators to help create a new body for England, bringing together our strengths with those of the Drinking Water Inspectorate, the Environment Agency and Natural England. We are also continuing to work with the Welsh Government to support decisions on the future arrangements for Wales.

While these changes take shape, our mission remains the same: to hold water companies to account, drive performance, and ensure the sector delivers real value for customers, communities, and the environment. If you’re passionate about making a difference, this is a unique moment to join us and help shape the future of water, and together we can continue to make a positive impact.

You can find out more about why you should join Ofwat, our strategy, values and our framework for success in the attached Information for Candidates Pack.

Job description

This role is based in the Customer Policy team within Ofwat's Casework, Enforcement & Customers Directorate.

The Customer Policy team is central to understanding company customer service and support, and acting where we identify potential harm and poor service. This includes in relation to customers who need extra help, whether financially or non-financially, and customer who experience repeated poor service and/or failures. We work closely with teams across Ofwat to identify appropriate action to improve customer service and protect customers, including considering new regulatory tools, interventions, and enforcement action.

Our team works with a diverse range of stakeholders, including water companies, new entrants to the sector, customer groups and charities, Government, other regulators, and customers. Communicating effectively with our customers and internal and external stakeholders is central to our team's success.

This senior associate in the policy profession is working across our customer policy and insights function. Our team, in CEC, leads Ofwat's aspiration to transform companies' performance with respect to customer service and support; and engagement with government and CCW on consumer matters. Recent examples of our work include developing guidance under condition G, the customer-focused licence condition; our assessment of companies' sewer flooding customer service and support; engagement with Government on changes being considered to the consumer landscape; and research with CCW into customers' experience of incidents such as supply interruptions.

Key deliverables:

In this role you will be expected to:

  • Successfully contribute to the development of Ofwat's customer policy work including in relation to financial and non-financial vulnerability. This includes analysing and reporting on data and information, understanding companies' performance in relation to support for customers needing extra help and supporting Ofwat in preparing responses to enquiries from Government, press and Parliament in relation to customer vulnerability;
  • Support the design and delivery of appropriate policy solutions to support company compliance and improved performance against Licence Condition G, our customer focused licence condition, being considerate of risks and opportunities;
  • Build and maintain effective relationships with key external stakeholders to optimise the impact of our work, including customers, water companies, representative bodies and Government departments as we prepare for water reforms;
  • Engage effectively with internal stakeholders to share insights and expertise from and for our customer policy work, to identify interdependencies and support delivery of better outcomes for customers, in particular supporting the New Appointee team in relation to customer service;
  • Provide support and guidance to members of the Customer Policy team to help develop work packages and contribute to the wider work programme and business as usual activities;
  • Create and champion an inclusive working environment that supports growth, well-being, and continuous improvement in our delivery.

Person specification

To be successful in this role you will need the below essential attributes, experience, skills and knowledge:

Experience, skills and knowledge

  1. Lead criterion: Experience of developing policy in a government, public sector or regulatory organisation.
  2. Lead criterion: Understanding of policy issues in relation to customer service, in particular supporting customers who may be financially and/or non-financially vulnerable.
  3. Experience of effectively planning, prioritising and managing a varied and changing workload, delivering high-quality work to often tight and competing deadlines.
  4. Ability to prepare deliverables with a high degree of independence, including reviewing customer research reports, drafting policy recommendations and preparing assessments of companies' performance.
  5. Experience of building and maintaining constructive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders to understand their needs and expectations, and to influence and collaborate effectively to deliver desired outcomes.
  6. Excellent written and oral communications skills, including concisely explaining policy in non-technical language.

Attributes

7. Champion and leader or change
8. Promotes collaboration
9. Adaptable thinker

Attributes as per Ofwat's Framework for Success for the relevant salary grade. You can read more about Attributes here.

Benefits

Why You Should Join Us:

Our people are at the heart of Ofwat, and our People Strategy defines the goals that keep this focus central to everything we do. Our 2025 People Survey highlights several key strengths. Nine in ten colleagues say that they are treated with respect and that Ofwat values individual differences. The same proportion say that their work is meaningful and that they are being trusted to carry out their roles effectively. 79% of our people rated their manager highly, and 85% described their team environment as positive.

You will also benefit from:

Campsfield IRC, Derwentside IRC, Dungavel IRC, Gatwick IRC, Haslar IRC, Heathrow IRCs (Colnbrook OR Harmondsworth), or Yarl's Wood IRC (Immigration Detention Centre)

ID staff permanently based in Campsfield IRC, Derwentside IRC, Dungavel IRC, Yarl's Wood IRC, Heathrow IRC and Gatwick IRC will be able to remain in their current location.

About the job

Job summary

Immigration Enforcement is responsible for enforcing the government’s immigration laws, tackling illegal migration, removing foreign national offenders and immigration offenders from the UK. We also aim to disrupt the organised criminal groups that exploit the vulnerable for their personal gain. Learn more on our careers pages.

The Detention Services Security Team provides second line assurance to local Detention Services (DS) Compliance teams, who work with Contracted Service Providers (CSPs) responsible for running Immigration Removal Centres (IRCs) in line with Home Office policies, contracts and standards.

Join the Detention Services Security Team and support important work to keep the immigration detention estate safe, secure and compliant.

Job description

The role supports a range of work across intelligence, security, use of force, health and safety and violence reduction. You will help support assurance activity, respond to operational queries and work with local teams and wider stakeholders on issues affecting safety and security across the detention estate.

You may be required to undertake the same or a similar role within a different team or teams (where possible, at your base location or within reasonable travel distance), depending on business priorities. With appropriate training and support, this will provide opportunities to broaden both your experience and skill set.

Key Responsibilities

  • Undertaking security reviews of IRCs to test physical and procedural security and monitor compliance with contractual and legislative standards.
  • Supporting security and intelligence processes, including handling referrals, maintaining registers and ensuring effective use of intelligence systems.
  • Collating, reviewing and analysing operational intelligence, identifying trends and producing regular reports to inform decision-making and senior management.
  • Conducting impartial assessments of use of force (UoF) incidents, providing clear, evidence-based feedback to support learning and compliance with policy.
  • Maintaining knowledge of current UoF techniques through annual training and required upskilling, and delivering training and awareness sessions.
  • Using Microsoft Office and other relevant IT systems effectively, with strong organisational, administrative and problem-solving skills to deliver high-quality work under pressure and to deadlines.
  • Communicating effectively verbally and in writing, including report writing, building professional relationships and engaging confidently with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Working independently, using initiative and adapting to changing priorities while contributing effectively as part of a team, demonstrating integrity and a commitment to continuous improvement and high standards.

Working pattern

Due to the operational needs of the role, including shift working, on-call duties and regular travel to IRCs, the post is only available on a full-time basis.

Shift working

Successful candidates will need to be able to attend for all shifts including early starts, late night finishes, and overnight shifts. These shifts may be outside of public transport operating hours.

The role includes shift working and on-call duties, acting as a point of contact for other teams on matters relating to intelligence, security and use of force.

Hybrid working

The current candidate information confirms that, where business needs allow, some roles may combine office and home-based working, with employees expected to spend a minimum of 60% of their working time in the office. However, this post is not suitable for home workers as regular deployment to IRCs is required.

Travel

Regular travel to IRCs will be required. This will mainly involve regional or national travel within the UK detention estate.

Overnight stays may occasionally be required, but these are expected to be limited and planned in advance where possible.

Person specification

Essential Criteria

  • Experience of using Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint, and other relevant IT systems.
  • Ability to organise and prioritise work, meet deadlines and maintain accuracy when working under pressure.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including report writing and working effectively with a range of stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, using initiative and adapting to changing priorities.
  • Ability to analyse information and data, identify trends and use findings to support high-quality work and improvements.

Licences

Due to the nature of the work and/or the geographical area, driving is a key requirement for this role. It is essential you hold a full valid UK manual or automatic driving licence at the time of application.

Behaviours

We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:

  • Working Together
  • Communicating and Influencing
  • Changing and Improving

We only ask for evidence of these behaviours on your application form:

  • Working Together

  • 25 days annual leave on appointment, rising with service to 30 days.
  • Eight days of public holidays, plus one additional privilege day
  • Where business needs allow, some roles may be suitable for a combination of office and home-based working. This is a non-contractual arrangement where all employees will be expected to spend a minimum of 60% of their working time in an office.

title: Sr. IT Manager - Goa or Pune (India)
description:
About the Role:
Eyelit Technologies (Eyelit) builds manufacturing execution and advanced planning software used by manufacturers worldwide. Our Enterprise IT function underpins both corporate operations and the infrastructure our product teams build on — spanning on-premises virtualization, public cloud, identity, security, and end-user computing.
We are hiring a Senior IT Manager to own day-to-day operations across that estate and lead the team that runs it. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set direction and standards, but you are also comfortable in a terminal, a firewall console, and a change review. You will be the escalation point for complex incidents and the person who turns recurring pain into permanent fixes. In return we offer a high-impact role, significant career growth opportunities, and a supportive, high energy culture where your contributions are truly valued.

Your Responsibilities:

Infrastructure & Cloud Operations
  • Own the health, capacity, and lifecycle of on-premises virtualization and hosted infrastructure across multiple sites, including hypervisor platforms, storage, and backup/DR.
  • Manage cloud infrastructure (Google Cloud and/or Azure/AWS): compute, Kubernetes, managed databases, networking, IAM, and cost governance.
  • Drive infrastructure-as-code and configuration management practices so environments are reproducible and documented rather than tribal knowledge.
  • Lead platform migration and modernization projects end to end — planning, risk assessment, cutover, and rollback.
Security, Identity & Compliance
  • Operate and improve the security stack: perimeter firewalls, endpoint protection, patch and vulnerability management, email security, and logging/monitoring.
  • Administer enterprise identity: Microsoft 365 / Entra ID, SSO and OIDC integrations, conditional access, MFA, privileged access, and joiner-mover-leaver processes.
  • Maintain evidence, controls, and audit readiness for SOC 2 (and support customer security reviews, questionnaires, and export-control/data-residency inquiries).
  • Lead incident response for security events: containment, remediation, root cause, and after-action reporting.
Team & Service Management
  • Lead, coach, and develop the IT team; set on-call and escalation expectations and build depth so no single person is a bottleneck.
  • Own the service desk experience: SLAs, ticket quality, knowledge base, and onboarding/offboarding that works on day one.
  • Run change management and maintenance windows with appropriate review, communication, and documentation.
  • Define and report operational metrics — uptime, ticket volume and aging, patch compliance, backup success, spend.
Vendor, Budget & Planning
  • Manage vendor and SaaS relationships: renewals, licensing posture, right-sizing, and consolidation opportunities.
  • Contribute to annual budgeting and produce cost analyses and recommendations for leadership.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Finance on shared infrastructure decisions and internal tooling.
Experience and Education:
  • 10+ years in IT infrastructure or operations, including 3+ years leading a team or function.
  • Deep hands-on experience administering both Windows Server, Linux and Macs in production.
  • Strong virtualization background (HPE VME, VMware vSphere, KVM-based platforms, or equivalent) including migration experience.
  • Production experience with at least one major public cloud, including Kubernetes and managed database services.
  • Solid networking fundamentals: routing, VLANs, VPN, DNS/DHCP, TLS, and enterprise firewall administration.
  • Practical scripting/automation ability (PowerShell, Bash, Python) and comfort with Git-based workflows.
  • Demonstrated ownership of security operations and a compliance framework such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or NIST CSF.
  • Clear written communication — able to produce a runbook, a post-incident report, and a recommendation memo for executives.
What We Value:
  • Strong leadership and collaboration.
  • Strategic thinking combined with a hands-on, proactive approach.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills.
  • A security-conscious and solutions-focused mindset.
  • Thrives in fast-paced, innovative environments with a growth mentality.
  • A commitment to continuous improvement.
Why Join Us:
  • Be a foundational team member in a high-growth, high-visibility expansion initiative.
  • Competitive base salary and benefits.
  • Professional development programs and career growth pathways.
  • Strong culture of collaboration, recognition, and support.
  • Opportunity to directly impact the digital transformation of leading global manufacturers.

About Eyelit Technologies:
Eyelit Technologies is a leading provider of integrated software solutions that optimize manufacturing plant and multi-plant productivity across complex industries such as semiconductor, automotive, medical device, electronics, and A&D. Its AI-powered suite of planning and execution solutions enables businesses to improve production processes, enhance asset utilization, streamline scheduling, and close the gap between planning and execution. Eyelit Technologies empowers organizations to drive sustainable growth, reduce costs, improve delivery performance, and gain greater visibility and proactive management of key business processes.

Eyelit Technologies is an equal-opportunity employer dedicated to creating a welcoming community and an environment free of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. We at Eyelit Technologies believe that great people make great organizations. We value our employees and provide a wide range of benefits.

Eyelit Technologies is committed to making the job application process accessible to everyone. If you are living with a disability (visible or not visible) and need to request reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process, please let us know how we can help by reaching out to careers@eyelit.com

title: Senior Analyst, Configuration
description:
Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring a Senior Analyst to join our Claims and Benefits Team.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.

About the role:

The Senior Analyst, Configuration supports the business by improving the consistency, accuracy, and efficiency of platforms, systems and processes. Through understanding of the platform configuration capabilities, this role helps ensure that processes are configured accurately.

You will report into the Manager, Configuration Operations.

Work Location: This position is based in our Tempe, AZ office, requiring a hybrid work schedule with 3 days of in-office work per week. Thursdays are a required in-office day for team meetings and events, while your other two office days are flexible to suit your schedule. #LI-Hybrid

Pay Transparency: The base pay for this role is: $67,813 - $89,004 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program, and annual performance bonuses.

Responsibilities:

  • Analyze and summarize process behavior in order to expedite the design/solutioning process
  • Translate configuration enabling internal teams to resolve escalations
  • Process incoming Jira tickets to support member escalation resolution
  • Identify and pilot opportunities to improve operational efficiency
  • Triage and manage workflows of ingested items
  • Investigate escalations via incoming tickets or informal pathways
  • Conduct necessary maintenance work and take on ad-hoc projects associated with Contract configuration
  • Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations
  • Other duties as assigned
  • Approve work-in-progress contact configuration inquiries to ensure configuration is possible
  • Assist with the continued documentation and implementation of workflow updates and processes

Requirements:

  • 2+ years working knowledge of health plan benefit concepts (e.g., deductibles, copays and other forms of cost sharing, etc.)
  • 1+ year of SQL experience
  • 1+ years claims processing experience

Bonus points:

  • 1+ year Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint and/or comparable programs within the Google Docs Editors suite (e.g., Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Slides).
  • 1+ year experience in Jira
  • Experience working in health insurance industry/claims
  • Experience working with Jira
  • SQL proficiency
  • Python Experience

This is an authentic Oscar Health job opportunity.

At Oscar, being an Equal Opportunity Employer means more than upholding discrimination-free hiring practices. It means that we cultivate an environment where people can be their most authentic selves and find both belonging and support. We're on a mission to change health care -- an experience made whole by our unique backgrounds and perspectives.

Sigma, Inc. connects talented professionals with leading organizations across healthcare, technology, and other industries. We are currently seeking a Remote Junior Product Manager – Customer Segmentation to support an enterprise product initiative with our client.

The Junior Product Manager – Customer Segmentation will help define, develop, and improve enterprise customer segmentation capabilities that enable the organization to better understand customer groups and make informed business decisions.

The role involves translating business needs into product requirements, supporting roadmap and backlog prioritization, collaborating with business and technology teams, and helping drive the adoption of segmentation solutions across analytics, customer insights, personalization, and customer engagement.

The ideal candidate has experience in product management, technology, software, or analytics and demonstrates strong communication, analytical thinking, organization, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Support the development and execution of product vision and strategy for customer segmentation capabilities.
  • Gather business requirements and identify customer needs, product opportunities, and potential use cases.
  • Translate business problems into clear product requirements, deliverables, and minimum viable product (MVP) scope.
  • Assist with product roadmap development, backlog management, and prioritization based on business value and stakeholder needs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business, data, analytics, technology, architecture, and governance.
  • Support the development and delivery of scalable, reusable customer segmentation solutions.
  • Help manage the product lifecycle, including segmentation definitions, validation, publication, updates, versioning, and retirement.
  • Drive product adoption by supporting integration into analytics, customer insights, personalization, engagement, and measurement workflows.
  • Monitor product performance and success metrics to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Evaluate stakeholder feedback, assess competing priorities, and communicate product decisions and trade-offs.
  • Support vendor solution assessments and contribute to build-versus-buy evaluations when needed.
  • Maintain product documentation and communicate priorities, progress, and updates to relevant stakeholders.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Mathematics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant education and experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in product management or a related product-focused role.
  • At least 3 years of experience working across the software, technology, or analytics product lifecycle.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional business, analytics, and technology teams.
  • Ability to translate business needs and ambiguous problems into product requirements, strategies, roadmaps, and prioritized backlogs.
  • Understanding of the product lifecycle, including discovery, planning, delivery, adoption, performance measurement, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage competing stakeholder priorities and communicate product direction and decisions effectively.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fully remote environment.
  • U.S. citizenship is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with customer analytics, customer intelligence, audience segmentation, or enterprise data products.
  • Familiarity with customer data, behavioral analytics, personalization, or customer experience platforms.
  • Experience driving product adoption across multiple business units or stakeholder groups.
  • Experience working in healthcare or other highly regulated industries.
  • Familiarity with vendor management, solution evaluation, and build-versus-buy assessments.
  • Experience defining product success metrics and using data to guide product improvements.

Schedule & Work Environment:

  • Fully remote position
  • Monday–Friday, normal business hours
  • Entry to junior-level product management opportunity
  • Contract-to-hire opportunity, with the intention of transitioning to a permanent role
  • Candidates must be based in the United States and be U.S. citizens

Why Join Sigma, Inc.?

  • Opportunity to work with a leading healthcare organization.
  • Contribute to customer analytics and enterprise product development initiatives.
  • Collaborate with business, data, analytics, and technology professionals.
  • Gain exposure to product strategy, roadmap planning, and customer segmentation solutions.
  • Explore a contract-to-hire opportunity with potential for long-term career growth.

How to Apply:

Interested candidates should submit an updated resume highlighting their product management, technology, software, or analytics experience.

Qualified candidates may be asked to complete a an assessment test as part of the screening process.

Please note that this is a fully remote, contract-to-hire opportunity, and U.S. citizenship is mandatory.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Cloud Engineer

Blip is a leading tech company focused on software engineering solutions for sports entertainment.We operate at scale. As part of Flutter Entertainment, we play an essential role in the Group's goal of becoming the global leader in online sports betting and iGaming, developing innovative products and platforms for over 14 million monthly customers worldwide.We are serious about Tech. We are problem-solvers with big ambitions, keeping a people-first mindset at the core of our work. We prioritize flexibility as we strive to deliver the best technological products and tackle the greatest industry challenges. Recognizing that everyone brings their own strengths, backgrounds and new perspectives, we empower you to be yourself. That uniqueness shapes the culture of belonging we are so proud of.

The Role

Flutter Technology are recruiting a cloud engineer to drive the implementation, automation, and operation of our AWS cloud platform. The platform will underpin the global services consumed by the groups well-known betting brands.

This is a fantastic opportunity to shape the technology choices across Flutter‘s cloud hosting platforms, working with all brands across the group to migrate and modernise their services, deliver technology to meet their needs, and promote knowledge sharing across the engineering community. The role will contribute to the evaluation and selection of AWS services, code and configuration management tooling and the variety of components required to achieve our group strategic objectives.

You must be effective at articulating technology requirements, promoting cloud enablement, migrations and the methodologies required to reduce risk and achieve desired outcomes. You should be comfortable working with cross functional global teams in dynamic organisations, as the role will have interdependencies with teams in AWS, our partners, and our own engineering teams across various functions in various brands.

The right candidate will have experience working with enterprise organisations on large scale migration/modernisation transformation projects. This will have involved a customer-obsessed and collaborative approach, coupled with a strong technical understanding to provide confidence and answer questions, an ability to engage and help crystallise business benefits of migrations, demonstrate an excellent technical understanding of cloud solutions, and a passion for helping to transform using cloud technologies.

What you’ll be doing

  • Build and operate a secure, performant, and cost-effective AWS Cloud Platform.

  • Automate system deployment and operations using Infrastructure as Code and configuration management tooling.

  • Maintain source code and artefact repositories.

  • Write and review platform code, offering constructive feedback to ensure code quality.

  • Enable and support engineering teams with the adoption of cloud services.

  • Triage incidents, problems, and risks impacting Flutter cloud services.

  • Write and maintain appropriate technical documentation.

  • Define, document, support, and approve LLDs for Flutter cloud services.

  • Support cloud architecture and function leads with developing the cloud technology roadmap and strategy.

  • Act as a trusted SME offering advice and knowledge sharing to the broader technology team and internal customers.

  • Create and drive adoption of standard operating procedures, policies, and runbooks.

  • Liaise with other group functions, building and maintaining relationships, and recognising opportunities for strategic collaboration.

  • Liaise with Third Party vendors and partners.

What you’ll bring

  • Building Support: We establish close relationships with our stakeholders, underpinned by trust, integrity, and respect. We are able to build awareness, understanding, and positive momentum behind the group technology strategy, often without being in a position to assert authority.

  • Objective: We are impartial and unbiased, ensuring equal treatment for all and that decisions are based on objective criteria.

  • Collaborative: We work effectively and in partnership with our stakeholders on shared goals that align towards the achievement of the group strategy. We foster a collaborative environment and assume the role of leader when required.

  • Adaptable: We understand and appreciate different and opposing perspectives on an issue and are able to adapt our approach in order to achieve a successful outcome.

  • Strategic Thinking: We think about the big picture and use that perspective to support our divisions to achieve competitive advantage through greater agility, faster time to market and a better customer experience.

  • Strategic Communication: We are proactive and considered in our approach to stakeholder communications. We actively listen, provide constructive feedback and help others to consider new perspectives.

We’d like you to master in

  • Building and operating Infrastructure and Cloud platforms, ideally within highly available AWS environments.

  • Strong network knowledge in the TCP/IP stack, Firewalls and AWS cloud Networking Services (AWS CloudWAN, DNS, AWS Network Firewalls)

  • Relocating, rehosting, refactoring and rearchitecting services into AWS.

  • Working with source control management (Git, GitHub) and CI/CD Pipelines.

  • Managing deployment assets such as AMIs, container images and artefacts.

  • Managing Infrastructure as code using CDK, Terraform, CloudFormation.

  • Orchestration and management of container platforms, preferably using Kubernetes.

  • Delivering systems in security compliant environments

  • Writing and maintaining technical documentation.

  • Sharing knowledge with your peers and across the wider engineering community.

  • Working in an agile environment.

  • Incident, change, problem, and risk management.

  • Bonus points for previous software engineering experience, coding, and automation.

This is what you should have. What do we have, you ask? Well...you can check our amazing perks & benefits right here !
So ... are you in?

title: Principal Software Engineer- (.NET)(15+ years) - 11702
description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. The Principal Software Engineer will serve as a backend architect and visionary leader, responsible for the overall design, strategy, and implementation of our core .NET services. This role requires a leader who can operate at both 30,000 feet—crafting long-term vision—and 3 feet—diving deep into C# code alongside our top engineers to solve critical problems.

What You’ll Do:

  • Architectural Vision & Strategy: Define and drive the long-term vision and multi-year strategy for Coupa's backend .NET architecture. Make strategic decisions on migrating legacy monoliths to highly scalable, cloud-native microservices.
  • Enterprise-Wide Technical Leadership: Act as a lead contributor on key or critical projects with broad design issues. Provide technical advice and counsel that impacts the technical and business direction of the entire company, extending across several departments.

  • Drive Innovation: Evaluate and implement cutting-edge technologies in distributed computing, asynchronous messaging (Kafka), and integrate AI/ML platform tooling directly into core business spend capabilities.
  • Cross-Department Delivery: Take responsibility for the delivery of complex backend services on set timelines by coordinating seamlessly across multiple engineering departments and product teams.
  • Mentorship & Standards: Serve as a subject matter expert on a wide range of specialty areas. Mentor Senior and Lead engineers, elevating the craft of backend engineering at Coupa.

What You Will Bring to Coupa

  • Experience: 15+ years of Software Engineering experience within an enterprise-grade B2B SaaS environment, with significant leadership and architectural roles.
  • Core Technical Mastery:
  • Deep, proven expertise in C# and the modern .NET ecosystem (.NET 8/10).
  • Extensive experience designing and scaling API-driven services and event-driven microservice architectures.
  • Profound understanding of modern cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure), container orchestration (Kubernetes), and high-throughput transaction processing.
  • Database & Data Architecture: Expert in SQL Server, NoSQL, relational database management, query optimization, and managing large-scale data processing under heavy concurrent loads.
  • Strategic Influence: Proven ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams without formal authority, driving alignment on complex technical decisions across senior leadership.
  • Execution in Ambiguity: A track record of thriving in ambiguity, transforming complex, high-level business problems into structured, actionable, and resilient technical solutions.

title: Senior HPC and LSF Operations Developer - EDA Infrastructure

title: Senior Operations Program Manager

At Vida, we help people get better- and we're helping the healthcare system get better, too.

Vida's team of Obesity Medicine-Certified Physicians, Registered Dietitians, Expert Coaches and Licensed Therapists takes a whole-person approach to care, helping people lose weight, reduce stress and improve their overall health.

title: Associate, Loan Originations
description:
SitusAMC is where the best and most passionate people come to transform our client’s businesses and their own careers. Whether you’re a real estate veteran, a passionate technologist, or looking to get your start, join us as we work together to realize opportunities for everyone, we proudly serve.

At SitusAMC, we are looking to match your unique experience with one of our amazing careers, so that we can help you realize your potential and career growth within the Real Estate Industry. If you are someone who can be yourself, advocate for others, stay nimble, dream big, own every outcome, and think global but act local – come join our team!

We are seeking a highly motivated and entrepreneurial Associate, Loan Originations (Business Development) to join our commercial real estate lending platform. This position is designed for individuals who thrive on relationship-building, prospecting, and creating new business opportunities through direct outreach.
The role is focused on the front end of the origination process, identifying and qualifying prospective borrowers, developing new relationships, and supporting senior originators through the early stages of transaction execution. The ideal candidate is energized by business development activities, enjoys interacting with clients, and wants to build a long-term career in commercial real estate loan origination.
This is an excellent opportunity for candidates with commercial real estate brokerage, mortgage brokerage, investment sales, or other sales-oriented real estate experience who are seeking a direct path into lending and loan origination.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Opportunity Sourcing

  • Generate new lending opportunities through proactive outreach to commercial real estate owners, operators, sponsors, and borrowers.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of prospective loan opportunities through phone calls, emails, networking, referrals, and market coverage.
  • Identify and cultivate relationships that lead to repeat business and long-term borrower partnerships.
  • Partner with the Head of Origination and senior originators to refine business development strategies, outreach campaigns, and prospecting efforts.
  • Maintain detailed pipeline activity and opportunity tracking within the firm's CRM platform.

Deal Screening & Qualification

  • Conduct preliminary assessments of prospective loan opportunities based on:
    • Property type
    • Loan size
    • Leverage requirements
    • Sponsorship profile
    • Alignment with the firm's lending strategy
    • Probability of successful CMBS execution
  • Gather borrower information and supporting documentation.
  • Complete loan opportunity summaries and qualification materials for internal review.
  • Present qualified opportunities to senior originators and coordinate a seamless handoff into the transaction process.

Origination Support

  • Support senior originators during the initial stages of transaction evaluation, quoting, and application issuance.
  • Remain actively involved throughout the Deal Received, Quote Issued, and Application Issued stages of the origination process.
  • Coordinate with underwriting and execution teams to facilitate efficient deal review and progression.
  • Participate in borrower meetings, transaction discussions, and internal pipeline review meetings.
  • Assist in maintaining visibility into active transactions and market opportunities.

Relationship Management

  • Develop and maintain relationships with borrowers, brokers, and other commercial real estate market participants.
  • Learn from and work alongside senior originators, gaining exposure to a variety of relationship management and origination styles.
  • Support ongoing client engagement efforts throughout the transaction lifecycle.

Qualifications

Preferred Experience

  • 1-5 years of experience in:
    • Commercial real estate brokerage
    • Mortgage brokerage
    • Investment sales
    • Debt placement
    • Business development
    • Commercial real estate advisory services
    • Commercial real estate lending

Ideal Candidate Profile

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated interest in creating opportunities through direct outreach and relationship development.

Candidates should be able to demonstrate:

  • Experience prospecting property owners, borrowers, or real estate investors.
  • Success developing opportunities through outbound calling, email campaigns, networking, and relationship building.
  • Comfort operating in a highly entrepreneurial and performance-oriented environment.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • A desire to build a career in commercial real estate loan origination.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

While financial and real estate knowledge is important, this role is designed for individuals who view themselves primarily as business developers and relationship-builders rather than pure underwriting or analytical professionals.

About the job

Job summary

The Defence Nuclear Organisation (DNO) is responsible for the provision of the nuclear deterrent, encompassing our submarines and nuclear warheads, while also advising on UK nuclear planning and fostering international co-operation on nuclear matters. With a multidisciplinary team of over 700 professionals, the DNO brings together expertise in science, engineering, finance, policy, programme delivery, and more. We work in partnership with the Royal Navy, the Submarine Delivery Agency and the Atomic Weapons Establishment as the Defence Nuclear Enterprise (DNE).

Here at DNO we strongly believe that diversity and inclusion is not only the right thing to do but is also essential for a thriving and successful organisation. We have a culture where differences are celebrated, and our people feel supported, included and empowered. Join us and be part of an organisation that truly values diversity and inclusion and makes a positive impact on the world.

Within DNO, the Warhead Group leads the UK nuclear warhead programme which provides a stockpile of reliable, safe and effective nuclear warheads to support the UK’s strategic nuclear deterrent now and in the future. This post sits within Warhead Portfolio Integration, which drives Warhead delivery through a portfolio-led approach. The team provides governance, reporting, approvals, assurance, change control and portfolio management across the Warhead Group, enabling effective decision-making and delivery. Working across WHG, DNO, AWE and wider Defence, Portfolio Integration supports the prioritisation, management and oversight of programmes and projects, providing senior leaders with the insight, assurance and governance required to deliver the portfolio successfully.

This is an exciting time for Portfolio Integration with great opportunities to contribute to a Defence priority. The team delivers through and for others, has strong exposure to senior leaders and works closely with our primary delivery partner, Atomic Weapons Establishment (AWE). We are on a journey to embed the recent Warhead Operations Model Change Programme, you will need to be comfortable with uncertainty, able to persevere through change, manage fast paced tasking and work across boundaries.

This position is advertised at 37 hours per week.

Job description

The Business Case and Change Manager works within the Planning and Control and leads the day-to-day operation of Warhead Group Category C/D (below £50M) investment approvals and portfolio change control governance. The role is the focal point for the WHG Approvals Panel and Change Control Board, helping project teams progress robust submissions, maintaining accurate governance records and giving senior leaders clear visibility of decisions, risks and emerging trends. This is an opportunity to work across Warhead Group, DNO, AWE and wider Defence, supporting high-profile decisions in a complex delivery environment.

You will join the Portfolio Integration Team within the Capability Strategy Directorate, supporting the Assistant Head of Approvals, Assurance and Change within the Planning and Control team.

As the Business Case and Change Manager, you will lead Warhead Group Category D investment approvals and change control governance, ensuring robust governance, effective decision-making and compliance with organisational policy. Acting as the focal point for the WHG Approvals Panel and Change Control Board, you will support project teams through approvals and change processes, provide governance expertise, and maintain oversight of portfolio approvals and change activity.

You will work closely with stakeholders across WHG, DNO, AWE and wider Defence to improve approval readiness, support timely decisions and drive continuous improvement across approvals and change control processes. The role provides functional leadership across investment approvals and change control governance but has no direct line management responsibility.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the operation of the WHG Approvals Panel and manage the Category C/D (below £50M) investment approvals pipeline, ensuring effective governance, timely decision-making and compliance with organisational policy.
  • Review and challenge Category C/D (below £50M) business cases and supporting evidence, advising project teams on governance routes, JSP 655 compliance and approval readiness.
  • Coordinate Cat C/D (below £50M) approvals activity across WHG, managing engagement with Finance, Commercial, scrutiny and governance stakeholders to support successful progression through the approvals process.
  • Produce and maintain governance outputs, including panel papers, briefs, outletters, action logs, decision records, trackers and management information.
  • Maintain oversight of approval decisions, actions, risks and dependencies, ensuring issues are escalated and tracked through appropriate governance routes.
  • Act as WHG functional lead and gatekeeper for change control, ensuring compliance with change governance policy and organisational requirements.
  • Review, challenge and quality assure Change Control Notes (CCNs), coordinating impact assessments and ensuring changes receive appropriate scrutiny and assurance.
  • Manage and maintain the WHG Change Control Log and associated governance records, ensuring an accurate audit trail of change activity and decisions.
  • Provide secretariat support to the Change Control Board, including preparation of agendas, papers, actions and decision records.
  • Produce management information and reporting to provide senior leaders with visibility of approvals activity, portfolio change, risks, impacts and emerging trends.
  • Analyse approvals and change activity, identifying systemic issues, lessons identified and opportunities to improve governance effectiveness, efficiency and compliance.
  • Provide expert advice and guidance to project teams, capability managers and senior leaders on investment approvals and change control governance.
  • Build and maintain effective relationships across WHG, DNO, AWE and wider Defence to support governance coherence, informed decision-making and successful portfolio delivery.
  • Drive continuous improvement across investment approvals and change control processes, championing best practice and improving governance maturity across the portfolio.
  • Support wider Portfolio Integration priorities and activities as required.

Person specification

Essential Skills:

  • Experience of working in project delivery, including change control, assurance or business case delivery.
  • Ability to quickly understand complex organisations, processes and stakeholder environments.
  • Ability to analyse a wide range of issues, prioritise effectively and manage competing demands.
  • Excellent organisational skills with a commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence a range of stakeholders.

Desirable Qualifications:

  • Nuclear Weapon Foundation Course (NSQEP - Accredited Course) (once in post)
  • A project delivery practitioner qualification would be desirable but not essential (e.g. P3O, Management of Portfolios (MoP), Managing Successful Programmes (MSP), Management of Risk (MoR), Association for Project Management (APM), PRINCE2 or equivalent qualification) Better Business Cases Foundation or Practitioner. APMG Change Management, Configuration Management or equivalent qualification.

Desirable Skills:

  • Experience of investment approvals, business case assurance or governance processes.
  • Experience of change control, configuration management or project controls.
  • Experience of reviewing and challenging business cases, change proposals or governance products.
  • Experience of developing governance processes, guidance, templates or training materials.
  • Experience of working within Defence, Government or another complex regulated environment.

Behaviours

We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:

  • Changing and Improving
  • Communicating and Influencing
  • Managing a Quality Service
  • Working Together

Alongside your salary of £46,040, Ministry of Defence contributes £13,337 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides (opens in a new window).
  • Learning and development tailored to your role
  • An environment with flexible working options
  • A culture encouraging inclusion and diversity

The MOD Privacy Policy Notice sets out how we will use your personal data and your rights.

Things you need to know

Artificial intelligence

Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Selection process details

*Candidates will be required to provide a Personal Statement of Suitability which should be a maximum of 750 words that sets out your motivation for applying and shows how your skills and experience meet the essential/desirable requirements for the role.

Behaviours:

  • Changing and Improving
  • Communicating and Influencing

If a large number of applications are received, the initial sift will be based on Changing and Improving, CV and Personal Statement only. However, evidence should be provided against all behaviours requested.

At interview, you will be assessed against the following behaviours and your experience.

  • Changing and Improving

The requirements for the role have been benchmarked and these will be used to sift all candidates, with those meeting the minimum requirements invited to interview.

Interviews will be conducted face to face at either Main Building, London, Abbey Wood, Bristol or AWE, Reading.

Candidates who are found to meet an acceptable standard at interview but are not successful in one of the advertised posts may be considered for similar roles within the Business Unit.

You will also be expected to achieve Developed Vetting clearance, above the normal clearance level expected for the MoD.

The Defence Nuclear Organisation plays a vital role in supporting the delivery of the UK’s independent strategic nuclear deterrent. To help enhance security, staff working for the DNO are encouraged to always exercise a high level of discretion in sharing information or talking about their work. As part of the application process, we ask that you do not tell anyone other than your partner or close family member about your application to join the DNO. Further information:

The Civil Service embraces diversity and promotes equal opportunities. As such, we run a Disability Confident Scheme (DCS) for candidates with disabilities who meet the minimum selection criteria.

As a result of the changes to the UK immigration rules which came into effect on 1 January 2021, the Ministry of Defence will only offer sponsorship for a skilled worker visa under the points-based system, where a role has been deemed to be business critical. This role does not meet that category, and we will not sponsor a visa. It is therefore NOT open to applications from those who will require sponsorship under the points-based system.
Should you apply for this role and be found to require sponsorship, your application will be rejected and any provisional offer of employment withdrawn.

The Ministry of Defence requires all candidates who are successful at interview to declare any outside interests. These declarations will be discussed with successful candidates following the interview process and before a formal offer of employment is made, as some outside interests may not be compatible with MOD civilian roles. This will not, in the majority of cases, prevent employment in MOD, but it is a measure that must be taken to ensure that appropriate mitigations can be put in place to manage any potential, perceived or actual conflicts of interest from the first day of employment.

The Ministry of Defence adopts a zero-tolerance approach to unacceptable behaviours, which includes bullying, harassment, sexual harassment, discrimination, and victimisation. You will not be eligible and will not be considered for this post if you have been dismissed from a role for such unacceptable behaviours within the last five years.
