title: Research Analyst - Uganda
description:
Laterite is looking for a new Research Analyst with an understanding of data analysis and a strong motivation to work in social and economic research to join our office in Kampala, Uganda. This role combines research design, data analysis, project management support, data quality analysis, and fieldwork coordination in a collaborative and fast-paced environment.

WHO WE ARE

Laterite is a data, research, and analytics firm working on complex development challenges. We partner with universities, global think tanks, international NGOs, multilateral donors, and government ministries. Our clients include the World Bank, TechnoServe, the Mastercard Foundation, and others.

We operate across the Netherlands, Rwanda, Ethiopia, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Sierra Leone, and Peru, with 90+ full-time staff and more than 2,000 enumerators. We believe meaningful impact requires being on the ground, building local teams, and establishing long-term trust. Our office culture is collaborative and gives people autonomy to grow into their roles.

THE ENVIRONMENT YOU’RE STEPPING INTO

You will join our team in Uganda in a high-trust environment. We are low on bureaucracy but high on individual accountability. You won’t be micromanaged here—we want you to use your judgment to solve problems, support our fast-paced field teams, and actively improve the systems you work with.

Laterite was founded in 2010 in Kigali, and our office in Kampala opened in 2018. Our project portfolio in Uganda is varied across multiple sectors, and ranges from data collection studies, where Laterite manages data collection for our clients, to full-cycle research projects, where Laterite is responsible for evaluation and sampling methodology, survey design and coding, data collection, data quality and analysis. The Uganda team has managed some of our largest data collection projects and phone surveys on topics spanning coffee agronomy, foundational learning and education, sexual and reproductive health, and renewable energy. Our team in Uganda currently consists of 5 team members.

HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT

1 Supporting research projects

— Support the ethical approval process, research design, and development of research instruments,

— Conduct quantitative and qualitative data analysis.

— Draft sections of reports and presentations for clients.

— Support communication with clients and internal project teams on project progress.

2 Contributing to data collection

— Code survey instruments using SurveyCTO and other ODK-based platforms.

— Collaborate with field teams to develop training materials and support enumerator trainings.

— Participate in field visits to understand and improve data collection processes.

3 Strengthening data quality and analysis

— Monitor, clean, and validate incoming survey data (by conducting high-frequency checks, for example).

— Work closely with field teams to resolve data quality issues.

— Support statistical analysis and interpretation of findings.

— Contribute to consultancy-quality reports and data-driven insights.

4 Contributing to business development (Optional)

If you are interested, there is also room to contribute to our business development efforts, either through proactive business development or by contributing to the development of technical and financial proposals.

Requirements

WHAT YOU BRING

We are looking for a colleague with strong quantitative data analysis skills and a motivation to work on socio-economic development research. Specifically, you have:

— A completed Master’s degree in Economics, Public Health, Development, statistics, or related fields.

— At least one year of professional experience in similar roles or tasks. (We welcome experience gained through internships, dissertation work, or participation in an academic research group, provided you can demonstrate how this experience meets the requirements of the role.)

— Strong quantitative data analysis skills and proficiency in Stata.

— Excellent written and oral communication skills in English and Kiswahili.

In addition, we welcome:

· Experience working with ODK-based platforms (e.g., SurveyCTO).

· Previous work experience in Uganda

· Additional software skills, such as knowledge of R or Python.

· Organizational and interpersonal skills, self-motivation and drive to work in a collaborative environment.

WHAT YOU’LL LEARN AND DEVELOP

— Technical research design, including sampling and impact evaluation methodologies.

— Project management and client communication.

— Advanced data analysis, statistical techniques, and coding skills.

— Report writing and presentation of findings in a consultancy-quality format.

Benefits

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

— Competitive compensation. $2,979 - $4,092 gross monthly salary (exact grade determined by experience/interviews), medical insurance, pension contribution, and 21 days of annual leave.

— Professional growth. We are also committed to supporting our staff’s learning, providing an annual learning budget of up to $1,000 per person and 10 days of time off for professional learning each year.

— Flexibility. We also provide remote work options in accordance with Laterite’s remote work policy.

READY TO BUILD WITH US? NEXT STEPS

— Online assessment. Complete a 30-minute online verbal reasoning and quantitative assessment. No special preparation is required. Link:

— Application. Candidates who successfully complete the online assessment will be invited to submit a brief screening questionnaire, along with their CV, through our online application system.

— Analytical assessment. Selected candidates will complete a technical exercise involving statistical analysis using Stata, R, or Python.

— Interviews. Candidates who successfully complete the analytical assessment will be invited to a first interview. The interview stage consists of up to three interviews.

DEADLINE

Applications will be considered on a rolling basis. Details on rolling applications can be found on the website: .

For questions about the role or application process, please contact jobs@laterite.com

title: Manager Operational Readiness
description:
As Manager Operational Readiness, you’ll lead the capability across Technology, bringing delivery, business and operational teams together to prepare new and changed services for successful transition. You’ll provide clear visibility of upcoming change while building a proactive, delivery-focused team.

About the role
You’ll establish Operational Readiness as a trusted delivery partner and source of information about Technology change. From early planning through implementation and review, you’ll ensure impacts are understood, teams are prepared and operational ownership is clear.

  • Lead the Operational Readiness vision, strategy and roadmap.
  • Develop a capable team through coaching, clear direction and practical support.
  • Maintain visibility of the Technology change pipeline, impacts and readiness status.
  • Coordinate readiness plans, handovers, support models and transition activities.
  • Facilitate collaboration and communication across delivery and operational teams.

  • Identify readiness risks, remove barriers and drive actions through to completion.
  • Proactively identify emerging change, readiness gaps and dependencies through delivery forums and stakeholder networks.

About you
You’re a proactive and people-focused leader who can turn complex Technology change into clear, practical actions. You build trusted relationships, communicate confidently and help teams take ownership of sustainable operational outcomes.

  • Demonstrated leadership in operational readiness, service transition or change implementation.
  • Experience leading delivery-focused teams across multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of operational support, service ownership and transition practices.
  • Experience facilitating readiness workshops, handovers and go-live preparation.
  • Strong planning, stakeholder engagement and influencing capability.
  • Ability to translate complex change into clear impacts, responsibilities and actions.

Join our team and play a part in supporting our members to move and live safely, securely and sustainably. title: IMDS Specialist
description:
Since 1965, Stoneridge has designed and manufactured advanced, award-winning technologies including driveline and transmission actuation systems, vision systems, emissions control systems, safety systems, and security and monitoring systems for vehicle OEMs in the commercial vehicle, automotive, off-highway and agricultural vehicle markets. We’re focused on the areas of greatest market need – both today and tomorrow. Our core products and technologies are aligned with industry megatrends including safety and security, vehicle intelligence, fuel efficiency and emissions. Join the Stoneridge Team as we continue to build upon our strong history and reputation for quality products to deliver innovative products and systems that address a need, exceed our customers’ expectations, and motivate our team.

Objective of the position

In this role, you will track upcoming PPAP activities across multiple projects and make sure material data sheets are ready on time for customer submissions. You will ensure that products comply with global and regional material regulations such as RoHS, REACH, ELV, TSCA, and OEM requirements, while staying up to date on changing environmental regulations. Further, you will have the responsibility of creating, reviewing, and submitting IMDS records for products and components, validating supplier data, and resolving any missing or incorrect information.

You will also act as the main point of contact for IMDS and environmental compliance, working closely with suppliers, buyers, project teams, account managers, and customers.

Characterization of activities

  • Track upcoming PPAP activities across projects and ensure material data sheets are prepared and available for customer submissions.
  • Verify and ensure compliance with regional and global material regulations including RoHS, REACH, ELV, TSCA, and relevant OEM requirements.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of environmental and material regulations such as REACH, ELV, Conflict Minerals, RoHS, GADSL, and customer specifications.
  • Create, validate, and submit IMDS records for products, components, and assemblies, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
  • Review and validate supplier IMDS data, resolve data gaps, and support troubleshooting with suppliers as needed.
  • Act as a key contact for IMDS and environmental compliance, collaborating with suppliers, buyers, project teams, account managers, and customers.

Education, experience and knowledge

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Environmental Science, Materials Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 2–5+ years of experience in IMDS or comparable materials declaration systems and product/environmental compliance (preferred).
  • Working knowledge of RoHS, REACH (including SVHC and SCIP), ELV, and other regional chemical and product regulations.
  • Experience working with BOM and PLM systems and managing complex material and compliance data.
  • Strong analytical skills, high attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office for data analysis, validation, and reporting.
  • Strong in interpersonal communication, stakeholder management and excellent communication skills in (business) English.

What we offer

  • A truly global working environment with colleagues across the world.
  • Strong opportunities for personal and professional growth in a fastgrowing, constantly evolving organization.
  • Comprehensive Confido health insurance.
  • A competitive salary and an attractive motivation package.
  • A friendly and supportive team culture, complemented by regular social and teambuilding events.
  • Employment details: Temporary position with a monthly salary, based in Tallinn.
  • A salary of €2400 - €3700

title: Healthcare Scientist Practitioner

description:

Location

This role is being offered as office/lab based at our Scientific Campus in Porton. Please note hybrid working is not available for this role.

When based at our scientific campus, you will be required to have a Counter Terrorism Check security vetting check as a minimum. For meaningful National Security Vetting checks to be carried out individuals need to have lived in the UK for a sufficient period of time. You should normally have been resident in the United Kingdom for the last 3 years as the role requires Counter Terrorism Check (CTC) clearance. In exceptional circumstances UK residency less than the outlined periods may not necessarily bar you from gaining national security vetting and applicants should contact the Vacancy Holder/Recruiting Manager listed in the advert for further advice.

About the job

Job summary

The Food, Water and Environmental Microbiology Services (FWEMS) Laboratories are specialist microbiology laboratories within the UKHSA. Based in 3 sites across the country, the laboratories are geographically well placed to work with local authorities to protect the public from health threats posed by contaminated food, water and the environment. The Porton FWEMS Laboratory provides a microbiology testing and advisory service to Local Authorities, Port Health Authorities, hospitals and commercial clients across the south and west of England. The laboratory is accredited to ISO 17025 and is recognised as an Official Laboratory for the microbiological examination of food and foodstuffs within the EU.

The post holder will act as a Healthcare Scientist Practitioner and provide a technical service to customers for the diagnostic testing of Food, Water and Environmental samples as an aid to the investigation of outbreaks, food poisoning and routine control. They will perform basic and more complex investigations providing specialised testing using complex equipment.

The post holder will develop working relationships and communicate regularly with a wide range of individuals, clinical and non-clinical, internal and external to UKHSA.

Working for your organisation

We pride ourselves as being an employer of choice, where Everyone Matters promoting equality of opportunity to actively encourage applications from everyone, including groups currently underrepresented in our workforce.

UKHSA ethos is to be an inclusive organisation for all our staff and stakeholders. To create, nurture and sustain an inclusive culture, where differences drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our workforce and wider communities. We do this through celebrating and protecting differences by removing barriers and promoting equity and equality of opportunity for all.

Please visit our careers site for more information https://gov.uk/ukhsa/careers

Job description

Quality Management Systems

  • Participate in activities necessary for the maintenance and development of the Quality System in accordance with UKAS requirements.
  • Support the laboratory’s accreditation to ISO 17025 and ensure compliance with UKAS and other accreditation and certification standards.
  • Assist the Quality Manager in ensuring good working practices and maintain a high standard of work, including participating in Internal Quality Control and External Quality Assessment schemes.
  • Assist, where appropriate, in regular audits of departmental procedures in support of the Quality Manager and assist in the analysis of the results.

Asset Management

  • Ensure efficient running and contribute to routine maintenance of all equipment, which will include high cost, complex equipment requiring calibration and regular maintenance.
  • Assist in the maintenance of stocks of reagents and consumables, ensuring that they are received, stored, verified and used appropriately.
  • Contribute to the care, maintenance and security of laboratory premises and equipment in order to ensure efficient and safe operation.

Management

  • Take responsibility for the supervision of the day-to-day activities of less experienced staff

IT Infrastructure

  • Become competent in the use of the laboratory’s IT systems and participate in the basic inputting of data into the system

Strategy, Policy and Service Development

  • Assist in the improvement and development of the service, in the interests of efficiency and in order to meet changing demands.
  • Support the implementation of new methods and technologies into the laboratory, in order to maximise quality and efficiency of testing.
  • Support and participate in FW&E surveys, trials and research work and projects in collaboration with other senior staff of the FWEMS laboratories.
  • Support appropriate income generation activities for the laboratory, in accordance with the National FWEMS objectives, in conjunction with the Laboratory Management Team.
  • Participate in periodic reviews of laboratory methods with respect to performance and relevance.

Security/Health and Safety

  • Ensure confidentiality and conformity to the requirements of the Data Protection Act, Caldicott principles and the Laboratory Information Systems and Technology Security policy.
  • Ensure that health and safety are afforded priority and to demonstrate commitment to health, safety and welfare of self, staff and visitors.
  • Ensure attendance of self and managed staff on safety training courses as required in the UKHSA Health and Safety Training Policy and other safety policies as appropriate.
  • Agree to implement safety objectives.
  • Ensure that a Laboratory/Office Safety Code is implemented. Ensure that risk assessments are implemented and maintained.
  • Report risks that cannot be controlled to the Laboratory Manager. Notify accidents, near misses, dangerous situations and shortcomings in health and safety via the appropriate management structure.

Person specification

ESSENTIAL CRITERIA

  • BSc (Hons) Science degree or BTEC with previous experience in microbiology OR equivalent experience
  • Understanding of quality management systems, especially in relation to UKAS Accreditation
  • Have extensive working knowledge of laboratory areas, including both practical and theoretical knowledge of the various methods employed. Also, to demonstrate a sound understanding of the basic scientific principles relevant to microbiology. Knowledge and understanding of laboratory safety requirements and procedures
  • Experience of automated testing systems
  • Skills for communication of complex information and administrative matters, requiring developed interpersonal and oral/ written communication skills
  • Skills for supporting project management, including ensuring that projects meet financial targets
  • Ability to work on own initiative and organise own workload with minimal supervision, working to tight and often changing timescales. Problem solving skills and ability to respond to sudden unexpected demands

Benefits

Alongside your salary of £28,547, UK Health Security Agency contributes £8,270 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides (opens in a new window).
  • Learning and development tailored to your role
  • An environment with flexible working options
  • A culture encouraging inclusion and diversity
  • A Civil Service pension with an employer contribution of 28.97%

Things you need to know

Artificial intelligence

Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance (opens in a new window) for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

Selection process details

This vacancy is using Success Profiles and will assess your Behaviours and Strengths.

Stage 1: APPLICATION & SIFT

You will be required to complete an application form. You will be assessed on the listed 7 essential criteria, and this will be in the form of a:

  • Application form (‘Employer/ Activity history’ section on the application)
  • 1,000 word supporting statement.

This should outline how you consider your skills, experience and knowledge provide evidence of your suitability for the role, with reference to the essential criteria.

You will receive a joint score for your application form and statement. (The application form is the kind of information you would put into your C.V –please be advised you will not be able to upload your CV. Please complete the application form in as much detail as possible). Please do not email us your CV.

Healthjobs UK has a word limit of 1500, but your supporting statement must be no more than 1,000 words. We will not consider any words over 1,000 words.

LONGLISTING

In the event of a large number of applications we will longlist into 3 piles of:

  1. Meets all essential criteria
  2. Meets some essential criteria
  3. Meets no essential criteria

If used, the pile(s) ‘Meets all essential criteria’ will proceed to shortlisting.

SHORTLISTING

In the event of a large number of applications we may conduct an initial sift, on the lead criteria of:

  • BSc (Hons) Science degree or BTEC with previous experience in microbiology OR equivalent experience

If you are successful at this stage, you will progress to interview & assessment.

Feedback will not be provided at this stage.

Stage 2: INTERVIEW

You will be invited to a single face to face interview at UKHSA Porton. In exceptional circumstances, we may be able to offer a remote interview.

Behaviours and Strengths will be tested at interview.

The Behaviours tested during the interview stage will be:

EXTERNAL-This vacancy is open to all external applicants (anyone) from outside the Civil Service as well as internal applicants.

SALARY INFORMATION

If you are successful at interview, and are moving from another government department, NHS, or Local Authority, the relevant starting salary principles for level transfers or promotions will apply. Otherwise, roles are offered at the pay scale minimum for the grade, but in exceptional circumstances there may be flexibility if you are able to demonstrate you are already in receipt of an existing, higher salary. Pay increases are through the relevant annual pay award for the role and terms.

Please be aware that the salary is based on the office location.

£28,547- £33,196 (National)

If this role is fixed term and you are not currently a Civil Servant, you will take up the post on a Fixed Term appointment; you may be able to take this role up as a Secondment. If this role is permanent, it may also be available as a loan (for existing Civil Servants only) or secondment arrangement, subject to business need and agreement from the hiring manager and, where applicable, the employee's home organisation.

If you're appointed to a role currently based at Canary Wharf, Colindale or Porton Down, please note that we'll continue investing in these sites for the next decade. As we get closer to the transition, we'll provide full information about relocation support available to staff.

title: Sociaal Werker in de wijk
description:
Ben jij iemand die mensen samenbrengt, kansen ziet en graag iets in beweging zet? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

De functie: Als sociaal werker in de wijk draag je bij aan een buurt waarin mensen elkaar kennen, zich verbonden voelen en mee kunnen doen. Je brengt inwoners samen, stimuleert onderlinge betrokkenheid en helpt ideeën uit de wijk uitgroeien tot initiatieven die mensen met elkaar verbinden.

De werkzaamheden:

  • Je brengt mensen samen. Je legt contact met inwoners, organisaties en andere betrokkenen en versterkt bestaande netwerken in de wijk.
  • Je zet ideeën in beweging. Je stimuleert initiatieven van inwoners en helpt deze verder te ontwikkelen.
  • Je bouwt aan buurten waar iedereen meetelt. Je draagt bij aan het voorkomen van eenzaamheid en zorgt dat verschillende groepen inwoners kunnen meedoen.
  • Je denkt in mogelijkheden. Je sluit aan bij wat inwoners nodig hebben en zoekt creatieve oplossingen die passen bij hun situatie of hulpvraag.
  • Je verbindt mensen en organisaties. Je bent de schakel tussen inwoners, SWOM, vrijwilligers en maatschappelijke partners.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je bent bereid om echt contact te maken met inwoners en hun omgeving.
  • Je bent zelfstandig en kunt methodisch werken.
  • Moed om nieuwe en creatieve vormen van samenwerken te bedenken.
  • Je bent zichtbaar en betrokken bij wat er speelt in de wijk.
  • Je kan goed netwerken en weet mensen en organisaties aan elkaar aan te koppelen.

Profiel:

  • Je beschikt over een opleiding Social Work of vergelijkbare opleiding.
  • Ervaring met wijkgericht werken is een plus.
  • Je hebt kennis van verschillende doelgroepen en de sociale kaart of de interesse om je hierin te verdiepen.
  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Ruimte om initiatief te nemen, ideeën uit te proberen en echt iets te betekenen voor inwoners.
  • Samenwerken met mensen die zich betrokken voelen bij de lokale samenleving en die geloven dat iedereen er toe doet.
  • Een salaris volgens de CAO Sociaal Werk - Welzijn & Maatschappelijke dienstverlening.
  • Uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden conform de CAO, waaronder een Individueel Keuze Budget, loopbaanbudget en pensioenregeling.
  • Een WGA aanvullende verzekering voor extra inkomenszekerheid bij arbeidsongeschiktheid.
  • Starten met een aanstelling voor een jaar (intentie onbepaalde tijd).

Wil je meer weten over deze interessante vacature? Neem dan contact op met Andrea du Pau (Teammanager Welzijn). Bereikbaar via telefoonnummer 0348 – 469109.

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description:
Senior Application Security Engineer
We are hiring a Senior Application Security Engineer to own application security across Product Engineering and make Treatwell's products secure by default. You own the security tooling, from SAST in the pipelines to DefectDojo, you are the first call when an application-layer incident needs a security engineer, and you work hands-on with the teams that build our products: pairing with their engineers to fix what the scanners, the annual pentest and real incidents find, closing the design gaps behind them, and sometimes picking up a specific security epic for a product such as Connect or Salonized. Each time, the team ends up able to do the next one without you.

This is a hands-on role. You will write code, read a great deal more of it, and own the security tooling in our pipelines. Our applications are Java and Spring Boot across Marketplace and Payments, Ruby on Rails in our SaaS products, React and TypeScript on the web, native iOS and Android apps in Swift and Kotlin, and a small amount of PHP. Marketplace and Connect ship through GitLab CI and ArgoCD onto Kubernetes (EKS) in AWS; Salonized ships through GitHub Actions. Everything is monitored in Datadog, and findings from secrets detection, dependency scanning and SAST flow into a self-hosted DefectDojo.

This is application security, not infrastructure security: cloud, Kubernetes and network controls sit with our Developer Experience and Platform Core teams, and you work alongside them. You report to the Head of Developer Experience and set your own security roadmap with the Heads of Engineering, aligned to the OWASP ASVS and the OWASP DevSecOps Maturity Model. We have no CISO: you present the security posture to the CTO and VP of Engineering on a fixed cadence, and your view carries weight because it comes from the code.
How you will work

  • Cross-area by default. The security tooling, the findings pipeline and application-layer incident support are yours across all of Product Engineering. When a product needs focused work, such as a security epic for Connect or Salonized, you pick it up with that team, agreed with its Head of Engineering. Infrastructure security stays with Developer Experience and Platform Core.
  • Fix with the team, not for the team. You pair on remediation and the team's engineers merge the fix, so the knowledge stays where the code lives.
  • Guardrails over gates. The default is a secure path that is quicker to use than to bypass: shared libraries, pipeline templates, pre-commit checks. Blocking is reserved for critical findings on new code and agreed with the area.
  • One queue. Findings land in DefectDojo and move into the team's backlog or Now/Next like any other work. There is no parallel security process.
  • Through the champions. You work with each team's Security Champion and the Security Champions guild. In eighteen months a threat model or an incident should not need you in the room.
  • Your own roadmap. You keep a short Now/Next/Later for security, agreed each quarter with the Heads of Engineering, separate from the DevX roadmap.
  • Posture, not paperwork. You present the security posture per area to the CTO and VP of Engineering on a fixed cadence, measured against the DevSecOps Maturity Model.

You will be responsible for:

  • Owning application security across Product Engineering and working hands-on with the teams to remediate vulnerabilities in our codebases, from authentication and session handling to payments flows and public APIs, including specific security epics for a product such as Connect or Salonized.
  • Owning the security tooling across all areas (secrets detection, dependency scanning, SAST, DefectDojo, threat modelling) and landing SAST in our pipelines: completing the proof of concept with the SAST vendors we are evaluating on two pilot teams, the Marketplace Checkout and Identity team and a SaaS team, tuning rules until engineers trust the output, and feeding every finding into DefectDojo rather than a new dashboard.
  • Making DefectDojo work without a human in the loop: team ownership synced from our service catalogue, every team's repositories covered, and an agreed rule for which findings block a pipeline and which only report.
  • Building secure defaults into the paved road so the secure way is the easy way: authentication and session libraries, input validation, secrets handling, dependency and container checks in the pipeline templates teams already use.
  • Running threat modelling with teams before the work is fully scoped, using and improving our AI-based threat modeller so that it answers an engineer's question plainly and produces backlog items with owners and dates.
  • Triaging findings from scanners, the annual penetration test and external reports, agreeing severity and ownership with the team, and tracking them to closure in DefectDojo against our severity SLAs.
  • Being the first security call for application-layer incidents across Product Engineering: leading the technical side, assessing with Legal whether personal data was exposed, writing the postmortem actions, and working with Customer Support and Payments on fraud and customer-flagged cases including phishing.
  • Owning our security vendor relationships: the annual penetration-test cycle with our testing partner (scoping, scheduling, remediation planning), the responsible-disclosure programme and the security@ inbox, and the SAST vendor once selected.
  • Acting as the security reviewer in our third-party risk process for new vendors and integrations, and answering the security questionnaires our partners send us.
  • Measuring the security posture per area against the DevSecOps Maturity Model and presenting it to the CTO and VP of Engineering on a fixed cadence.
  • Growing the Security Champions programme with the Head of Developer Experience: a named champion in every team, demo-led guild sessions, and two security improvements per area shipped through team backlogs each quarter.
  • Keeping a short, current security roadmap (Now/Next/Later), agreed with the Heads of Engineering each quarter and visible to Product Engineering.

About you

  • You have worked as an application security engineer, or as a backend engineer who owned security for a product, and you fix vulnerabilities yourself rather than only reporting them.
  • You read and write production code in at least one of our languages (Java, Ruby, TypeScript) well enough to pair on a fix, review a merge request and spot the second bug behind the first.
  • You know the OWASP ASVS and Top 10 from code rather than slides, and you can run a threat model that ends in backlog items rather than a document.
  • You have put SAST, dependency scanning or secrets detection into CI pipelines (GitLab CI or GitHub Actions) and tuned the rules so developers kept trusting them.
  • You have worked with a vulnerability management platform and you know how to keep a finding moving to closure without chasing people by hand.
  • You understand how authentication, sessions, authorisation and payments flows break in practice: IDOR, token and magic-link misuse, JWT validation mistakes, race conditions, injection, and the odd device-id collision.
  • You know enough AWS and Kubernetes to see where application security meets the platform, and when to hand a problem to the platform team instead.
  • You explain risk in plain language to engineers, Heads of Engineering and non-technical leaders, and you can say "this one is fine" as clearly as "this one is not".
  • You transfer skills on purpose: your measure of success is a team that does not need you for the next one.
  • You use AI tooling as a normal part of the work, for threat modelling, code review and reading unfamiliar codebases, and you know where it is wrong.

Nice to have

  • Experience in a marketplace, payments or SaaS business handling card data and personal data under PCI DSS and GDPR.
  • A bug bounty, CTF or penetration-testing background, or an offensive certification such as OSCP, OSWE or BSCP.
  • Running or scaling a Security Champions programme.
  • Familiarity with the OWASP DevSecOps Maturity Model or another maturity framework.
  • Hands-on time with WAF and bot protection, secrets management, and infrastructure-as-code scanning, ideally in AWS.
  • Spring Security or Rails security internals; writing custom SAST rules.

We’ll treat you with:

  • 28-days holiday, plus bank holidays
  • Monthly €40 Treatwell vouchers so you can treat yourself too
  • Mental health support through our partnership with Open-Up
  • Market-specific benefits that will be discussed in the interview process

Equal Opportunities

Treatwell is an 'Open to All' employer and warmly welcomes everybody to the team. We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process as required. Please add any adjustment requests to your application.

title: Off-Cycle Student - Business Analyst
description:
Are you between studies, taking a study break, or focusing on personal projects after graduation while looking for an exciting part-time role? If so, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

In a nutshell

As an Off-Cycle Student Business Analyst at Picnic, you’ll be at the forefront of innovation, tackling complex challenges with fresh, groundbreaking solutions. This role is all about driving impact—you’ll analyze data, help identify opportunities, and support strategies that push boundaries and redefine the grocery shopping experience. You’ll join a dynamic and collaborative team in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

Tricks of the trade

  • Solving real-life puzzles: Tackle critical business questions that shape Picnic’s business model every day. Curious about the questions?
  • Enabling: Achieve operational excellence by approaching challenges with a data-driven and analytical mindset
  • Building: Create and optimize models for real-time improvements
  • Communicating: Work effectively with different teams to deliver impactful and sustainable solutions
  • Owning your projects: Take initiative by challenging the status quo and rethinking how things are done. Just because it’s been done that way doesn’t mean it’s the best way. Try us!

Your superpowers

  • You are in between your Bachelor and Master or are taking a study break from Aerospace, Mechanical, Industrial, Automation or Production Engineering; Mathematics; Econometrics; AI; or equivalent*
  • Passion for data analytics and business consulting
  • You have the ability to explain complex analytical concepts in a comprehensible manner to various stakeholders
  • Proficiency with SQL and Python or are excited to learn
  • You are fluent in both written and verbal English and have an EU citizenship available
  • Available for minimum 16h per week for minimum 4 months, preferably more

Depending on your performance, we can discuss further opportunities at Picnic!

*Active study enrollment is not required

Where you can make an impact

Logistics – Optimize the backbone of our operations, from fulfillment centers to last-mile delivery and demand forecasting across Europe. Think: automating international delivery forecasts for growth markets like France.
Tech – Build scalable backend systems, cutting-edge AI workflows, and internal tooling that power our entire platform. Think: building AI agent workflows (using Python, Claude, and SQL).
Consumer – Drive customer growth and strategic category development across our markets. Think: optimizing search algorithms for recipe discovery and running deep-dive analyses on customer retention and membership strategy.

Why Picnic

Grow as we grow. From day one, you’ll take ownership of real business projects that affect millions of customers, gaining hands-on experience.
Learn from top minds. Work alongside driven, talented mentors in a high-energy environment. You'll build, solve problems, and celebrate together, from our legendary Friday drinks to team events and parties.
Kickstart your career. Earn a competitive student salary with flexible working hours.

Picnic Perks

🚀Every expert was once a beginner!
You’ll have plenty of chances to grow, whether it’s through our casual Lunch & Learn sessions or team specific trainings. We’re especially keen on keeping great talent around: perform well as an off-cycle student business analyst, and we would love to explore transitioning you into a full-time role.

🌍Make a difference
You’ll work in an awesome startup environment with the freedom to drive your own projects and create a visible impact. Our fully electric vehicles and sustainable business model mean you’ll also be contributing to making the world a better place!

🤝Teamwork makes the dream work
With more than 80 nationalities across 3 countries, you’ll be part of a diverse company with plenty of cool stuff to get involved with, from board game evenings to after-work drinks to our company ski trip and more!

🥗Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks

Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen and chefs. They prepare delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up.

💪Stay healthy
Mental health is important. As well as having the option to speak with Picnic colleagues who act as confidential advisors, our collaboration with OpenUp gives you easy access to professional psychologists, along with workshops and materials.
There are plenty of sports communities and events to get involved with, from tennis to yoga to climbing!

💰Attractive package
We offer competitive compensation and a pension plan that looks out for your future self.

title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
Senior Database Administrator

PayTrace - Remote

PayTrace by North - Payment and ACH processing, virtual terminals, and more. The B2B payments expert transforming financial and accounting processes to future-proof your business. With advanced payment automation solutions and a user-friendly API, we help B2B companies become more efficient, successful, and profitable.

The Senior Database Administrator is an essential member of the Technology team, taking ownership of PayTrace’s entire database environment, which includes managing and maintaining production and development databases across multiple platforms. This role requires a highly critical thinker capable of making rapid, well-informed, and independent judgments to support PayTrace’s business-critical systems.Key responsibilities include provisioning, installation, configuration, operation, maintenance, patching, and general support of database systems. This person will also design and architect innovative database solutions, including modernizing the database infrastructure by migrating from MS SQL server to the AWS RDS environment.

What you'll do:

  • Database Management & Operations:
    • Create and maintain databases and hosts for Production, Development, and various Test environments.
    • Ensure database availability and recoverability meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and guidelines.
    • Rapidly and accurately resolve database issues utilizing all available tools.
    • Continuously monitor and tune database performance. Ensure integrity and availability of all resources, systems, and key processes, including reviewing logs and verifying that scheduled jobs (e.g., backups) are complete.
    • Perform periodic performance reporting to support capacity planning.
    • Available to address production issues which may require evening, overnight, weekend, and holiday work.
  • Architecture & Development Support:
    • Automate system administration with a focus on resource efficiency and scalability.
    • Design, implement and maintain database security based on best practices, company security standards and regulatory compliance.
    • Provide solutions to development teams when proposed architecture does not support technology strategy.
    • Assist developers with designing and tuning database queries and procedures.
    • Understanding of Technology vision, strategy, infrastructure standards, database platforms, programming languages, and observability and monitoring tools.
    • Migrate legacy database structures to support the modernization of the payment processing platform using microservice architecture.
    • Support the Disaster Recovery (DR) strategy and a multi-region active-active setup.
    • Support data pipeline automation to Snowflake.
    • Create and assist users in creating Business Intelligence (BI) reporting.
  • General & Leadership:
    • Provide technical guidance to data stakeholders.
    • Regularly update and review contributions to operational, configuration, and other procedural documentation.
    • Make rapid, well-informed, independent judgments in support of PayTrace’s business-critical systems.
    • Perform other tasks as assigned by management such as running various reports for the leadership team and data stakeholders.

What we need from you:

  • Education & Experience:
    • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology/Computer Science or an engineering field.
    • Minimum of 5 years of experience supporting databases in an enterprise environment, with at least half of that time primarily in a PostgreSQL environment.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Solid knowledge of PostgreSQL version 15.x and MS SQL 1219/2022, with the ability to share that knowledge.
    • Experience supporting a Relational Database Management System (RDBMS) in both Linux and Windows environments.
    • Proven experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) technologies: Postgres RDS, SQL Server RDS, Aurora RDS and EC2.
    • Experience with Database High Availability / Replication technologies (e.g., AlwaysOn, Postgres HA).
    • Scripting and automation experience.
  • Professional Skills:
    • Experience with troubleshooting problems and formulating resolutions with IT systems and individuals.
    • Ability to interact with a variety of clients in a clear, concise, and professional manner.
    • Solid understanding and working knowledge of the complete systems development and deployment lifecycle.
    • Working knowledge of all facets of systems administration in a large-scale IT operations unit.
    • Ability to make effective decisions in high-pressure situations with limited management escalation.
    • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

How to stand out (Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with Microsoft / Linux administration.
  • AWS Certification is a plus.
  • Microsoft MCDBA is a plus.

Salary Range: $110,000-$175,000

title: Principal Software Development Engineer- Go
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Principal Software Development Engineer (Service Platform & Orchestration) to join our team. This is a Hybrid (3 days in office) role, reporting to the Director, Software Engineering in the Zero Trust Exchange department. In this high-ownership position, you will engineer the management plane and reliability systems that govern ZIA’s fleet lifecycle at massive scale.
This is a hands-on building role where you will lead the transformation of our infrastructure from legacy automation into a stateful, durable management plane (built on Temporal) to achieve deterministic “one-touch” provisioning and lifecycle operations. You will treat “infrastructure as a distributed system,” developing self-healing capabilities and AI-driven SRE practices for a global fleet of 100k+ instances.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)
  • Lead the hands-on development and migration to a workflow-as-code platform (Temporal), building replay-safe, idempotent workflows that ensure deterministic operations across a global scale
  • Move the organization beyond “scripted automation” toward a robust management plane that treats the entire global fleet as a single, eventually-consistent distributed system
  • Design and implement services that leverage LLMs and ML for intelligent signal correlation, automated triage, and “self-correcting” fleet operations
  • Develop framework-level services and internal APIs that ensure all new products are delivered “orchestration-ready” with reliability hooks built directly into the code
  • Build deep telemetry (metrics, traces, and events) into the management plane so that every fleet-wide action is fully explainable, auditable, and replayable
Who You Are (Success Profile)
  • You thrive in ambiguity. You’re comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. You adapt to what’s needed, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You operate with urgency. You understand that in a high-growth environment, speed and quality are not mutually exclusive. You have a relentless focus on execution and a bias for action, delivering high-impact results quickly to win for the customer and the team.
  • You think at scale. You connect your day-to-day work to the larger company mission and think globally. You build solutions, processes, and teams that are not just effective today but are built to last and support a high-growth, global organization.
  • You are resilient and adaptable. You view change as an opportunity and setbacks as temporary. You maintain composure and focus in high-pressure situations, guiding yourself and your team through complexity with a steady, positive hand.
What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)
  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • BS/MS in Computer Science or a related technical field with 12+ years of experience in hyperscale systems, with a deep understanding of the unique failure modes and technical hurdles that only emerge at massive scale
  • Mastery of backend systems languages with a strong preference for Go (or deep expertise in Java, C++, or Python with a demonstrated ability to rapidly adopt Go), along with a proven track record of setting the bar for code quality and distributed system correctness.
  • Strong experience designing and operating complex distributed systems, with a focus on solving systemic challenges in concurrency, failure handling, and performance optimization
  • Proven track record of developing Platform APIs (REST/gRPC) with strong guarantees for idempotency, verification, and safe rollout patterns
What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)
  • Proficiency with AI code-assistance tools (e.g., Cursor, Windsurf) to accelerate legacy refactoring and system development
  • Proficiency in PostgreSQL, or other relational stores used for high-scale, stateful management-plane services
  • Direct experience building or operating systems with , Cadence, or similar workflow engines

title: Cyber Incident Response Consultant
description:
Thanks to continued growth, we are now looking for a Cyber Incident Response Consultant to join us in our London office. As the Cyber Incident Response Consultant you will be responsible for delivering Control Risks' Cyber Incident Response projects for clients. Working as part of a team on high-profile incidents, you will undertake compromise assessments and business email compromise investigations, as well as investigate and help lead the technical response to complex cases, including ransomware attacks. The role also contributes to developing the investigative toolsets and automation used by the practice. Reporting to an Associate Director of Cyber Response, you will work closely with the Cyber Crisis Management team. The successful candidate will have an incident response background; technical expertise spanning infrastructure, web servers and cloud environments; a deep understanding of current and emerging threat actors; and a genuine interest in developing tooling that improves the delivery of investigations. Please note that this role will require you to work at least three days per week from our London office on a hybrid basis.

Tasks and Responsibilities

Incident Response

  • As part of the cyber incident response team leading and assisting with host, network, web server and cloud-based investigations into complex cyber incidents, including ransomware attacks.
  • Investigate incidents affecting SaaS platforms and software development environments (e.g. source code repositories and CI/CD pipelines), drawing on an understanding of common development practices.
  • Threat hunting and identification of attacker activity, using EDR and agent-led forensic tooling, to inform the investigation and containment activities
  • Perform live compromise assessments for organisations who suspect live and ongoing system intrusion.
  • Detect and hunt unknown live, dormant, and custom malware in memory across multiple systems in an enterprise environment.
  • Contribute to the design and development of investigative toolsets and automation, and assist with commercialising the technology developed to ensure it is fit for purpose.
  • Demonstrate an understanding of both existing and emerging threat actors, as well as experience identifying rapidly changing tools, tactics and procedures of attackers.
  • Work with the Cyber Threat Intelligence team to identify where they could benefit from the technical information acquired during Cyber Response cases. Also identify and implement where threat intelligence can be leveraged through tooling and automation.
  • Advise on the safe technical recovery of an organisations IT systems balancing the need to understand what has happened but speed up recovery.

Client Management

  • Ensure tooling and automation developed is customer friendly to deploy and use. Be responsible for any customer queries that arise from the use of the technology and automation.

Reporting

  • Provide situation reports and other significant case related material to the client, case lead, and team leadership.
  • Provide documentation to the relevant consultants in sufficient time to allow review and feedback, before submitting to a client.
  • Contribute to high quality client reports highlighting technical findings in a structured and defensible manner.

Supporting the growth of the Cyber Response practice

  • Discuss and input into Control Risks’ cyber response methodologies and approaches whilst tailoring the approach in changing market conditions.
  • This role has a requirement to join the team’s on call duty rota.
  • Identifying potential new areas of growth and opportunity.

Requirements

Essential

  • Proven experience investigating complex cyber incidents, including ransomware attacks, as part of an incident response team
  • Technical degree or demonstrated knowledge of common networks, software and hardware used in business environments
  • Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure, web servers and cloud environments (e.g. Microsoft Azure / Entra ID, AWS, Google Cloud), including how they are attacked and investigated
  • Experience in conducting log analysis and digital forensics following a cyber incident
  • Proven experience in responding to cyber-attacks
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken)
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent analytical skills
  • Scripting and or development experience
  • Demonstrable investigative mindset and independent research of complex incidents and interest in developing investigative toolsets and automation to support and enhance our cyber incident response practice

Preferred Qualifications and specialist skills

  • Strong understanding of MITRE ATT&CK techniques / sub-techniques. The ability to articulate TTPs to clients in non-technical terms.
  • Experience in generating SIGMA rules for host detection, SNORT rules for network detection and YARA Signatures for file and memory artefact identification.
  • General understanding of common SaaS platforms and software development practices (e.g. source control, CI/CD pipelines, APIs), sufficient to investigate incidents affecting these environments.

Benefits

  • Control Risks offers a competitively positioned compensation and benefits package that is transparent and summarised in the full job offer.
  • We operate a discretionary global bonus scheme that incentivises, and rewards individuals based on company and individual performance.
  • Control Risks supports hybrid working arrangements, wherever possible, that emphasise the value of in-person time together - in the office and with our clients - while continuing to support flexible and remote working.
  • As an equal opportunities employer, we encourage suitably qualified applicants from a wide range of backgrounds to apply and join us and are fully committed to equal treatment, free from discrimination, of all candidates throughout our recruitment process.

If you require any reasonable adjustments to be made in order to participate fully in the interview process, please let us know and we will be happy to accommodate your needs.

title: Embedded QA Engineer
description:
Embedded QA Engineer

Bring your curiosity. Bring your troubleshooting skills. Expect to get hands-on.

A device stops responding. Is it the software, a network setting, a loose connection or something nobody has thought of yet? If you enjoy following the evidence until you find the answer, you could be exactly who we’re looking for.

At Vix Technology, we’re looking for an Embedded QA Engineer to test the software behind physical devices, displays and on-vehicle equipment. Your work will help us release reliable products that perform in the real world—even when the power drops, the network disappears or a device needs to recover on its own.

What you’ll get stuck into

You’ll take ownership of manual and system-level testing, setting up equipment, installing software builds and creating reliable, repeatable test environments. From checking everyday functionality to exploring awkward edge cases, you’ll put our products through their paces and provide clear evidence of what’s ready for release.

Some days, you’ll be working through Linux logs, checking application behaviour or investigating communication between devices and supporting services. On others, you’ll be tracing a wiring fault, making a test cable or reaching for a multimeter. You’ll need to feel equally comfortable at the command line and the test bench.

You’ll explore how equipment behaves during startup, shutdown, reboots, power loss and network interruptions. When something fails, you’ll reproduce the problem, work out where it originates and give developers the detail they need to resolve it.

Along the way, you’ll keep test plans, defect reports, release versions and device configurations accurate and easy to follow. You’ll also run existing automated tests, investigate failures and help identify where additional coverage would make a difference. Sharing discoveries and supporting junior colleagues will be part of the job too.

Requirements

What you’ll bring

We’re interested in people who combine strong testing instincts with practical technical skills. You should have:

  • Experience testing software on embedded hardware, with strong manual, exploratory and integration testing skills.
  • Confidence troubleshooting embedded Linux using command-line tools, SSH, logs, process checks and configuration files.
  • Practical networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, ports, static IP addresses, gateways and DNS.
  • Hands-on electronics skills: making and repairing cables, soldering and crimping connections, reading wiring diagrams and schematics, and using multimeters and oscilloscopes to investigate faults.
  • A clear, methodical approach to test documentation, release records and defect reporting, with experience using tools such as Git and Jira.

You’ll be comfortable investigating across software, operating systems, networking, power and hardware, including unfamiliar or legacy platforms. You don’t need advanced circuit design experience, but you should be able to set up equipment safely and investigate hardware-related failures independently.

A few useful extras

Experience with Robot Framework, scripting in Python or Bash, MQTT, serial communications, GPIO or watchdogs would be welcome. Familiarity with Windows CE, .NET Compact Framework, Docker, simulators or device connections to cloud and back-office services would also come in handy.

We’re open to thoughtful use of approved AI tools to help develop test scenarios, analyse findings and improve documentation. You’ll remain responsible for checking the results and protecting confidential information.

Sound like your kind of challenge?

You’re curious, persistent and organised. You can work through incomplete documentation, explain a tricky fault clearly and keep investigating when a problem only appears once every twenty reboots.

If you enjoy understanding how the whole system works—and helping make it more reliable—we’d love to hear from you.

Benefits

Besides the opportunity to work for a global company that is customer and people focused, we offer:

  • A focus on learning and development
  • A great team of like-minded professionals
  • Private Healthcare
  • Income Protection Scheme
  • Pension

  • Cycle to Work Scheme
  • Electric Car Benefit Scheme

title: Senior Director, Creative Production
description:
Business Insider is hiring a Senior Director, Creative Production to lead BI Studios' branded content team and create exceptional storytelling for our advertising partners.

Business Insider is for people who are driven, optimistic and always looking forward. Our mission is to inspire action through thought-provoking stories. We tell our audience what they want and need to know to improve their lives and the world with storytelling that is accessible, smart, sometimes unexpected, and always helpful. Our team members embody and uphold Business Insider's three core values: we are all one team, we are effective, and we get better every day.

BI Studios is the award-winning branded content studio at Business Insider, creating premium storytelling for many of the world's leading brands. We produce everything from feature articles and documentaries to social content, vodcasts, interactives, and emerging formats.

Our work sits at the intersection of editorial, creativity, and marketing. We're entrepreneurial, collaborative, and constantly experimenting with new ways of reaching audiences. As Business Insider evolves alongside AI and changing audience behaviors, we're investing in the future of branded storytelling and looking for a leader to help build it.

The Role & Team

As Senior Director, Creative Production, you'll lead BI Studios' creative organization, including Content Producers, Project Managers, Video Production, and a network of freelance creative partners. You'll partner with Creative Strategy, Sales, Design, and Client Success teams to translate client objectives into ambitious storytelling that delivers meaningful business results.

This is a player-coach role where you'll balance strategic leadership with hands-on creative work, whether that's editing content, reviewing a documentary cut, shaping a client presentation, or leading a major client conversation.

Reporting to the VP of Creative Strategy & Studios, you'll raise the creative quality of BI Studios' work by defining creative standards, mentoring the team, and ensuring every campaign reflects the creative ambition and editorial rigor of the Business Insider brand.

This position is based in our New York City headquarters with an in-office expectation of at least three days per week and may require some travel.

Key Responsibilities

Creative Leadership

  • Serve as BI Studios' senior creative leader, overseeing flagship campaigns and elevating storytelling, narrative, and creative quality across the board.
  • Establish and uphold BI Studios' creative standards, editorial voice, and storytelling principles.
  • Develop new storytelling formats, products, and creative capabilities that keep BI Studios at the forefront of branded content.
  • Lead the team while remaining hands-on with the work, from editing content and reviewing scripts and video cuts to strengthening narratives across the portfolio.
  • Stay ahead of trends across AI, audience behavior, media, and content discovery, translating them into new opportunities for BI Studios.
  • Foster a culture of experimentation that produces award-winning work and continually raises the creative bar.
  • Partner with Creative Strategy and Sales to deeply understand client objectives and ensure every campaign balances creative excellence with measurable business outcomes.

Production Leadership

  • Oversee all custom production across articles, video, social, vodcasts, interactives, and emerging formats.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, on budget, and at an exceptional creative standard.
  • Support project managers in building scalable systems and processes that support ambitious creative work while improving efficiency.
  • Identify opportunities to thoughtfully integrate AI into creative and production workflows.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop a high-performing creative production organization.
  • Co-lead hiring, organizational planning, and talent development with the VP of Creative Strategy & Studios.
  • Build a culture rooted in collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Foster an environment where team members are empowered to grow creatively, think strategically, and do their best work.

The Ideal Candidate Has

  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams across editorial, video, social, and digital content.
  • Outstanding editorial judgment, storytelling instincts, and creative taste.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate client marketing objectives into compelling, audience-first creative ideas.
  • Executive presence and confidence working with senior clients and stakeholders.
  • Client-facing experience with the ability to confidently lead creative conversations.
  • A track record of mentoring and developing creative talent.
  • Experience creating award-winning branded content and/or editorial storytelling.
  • Experience using AI to enhance creative development, production workflows, or content strategy.
  • Experience managing production budgets, resources, and creative workflows.
  • Curiosity about how AI is reshaping content discovery, search, audience behavior, and creative workflows.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Calm, thoughtful decision-making under pressure.

Salary & Benefits

  • Base salary: $160,000 - $170,000 (dependent on skills, experience, and competencies)
  • Additional bonus
  • Flexible PTO, 10 company holidays, and 16 weeks of parental leave
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans
  • Matched and vested 401k plan
  • Access to resources for financial planning guidance, family planning services, mental health support, and Employee Assistance Programs (EAP)
  • Additional benefits include commuter benefits, phone reimbursement, gym membership discounts, and more

We encourage members of traditionally underrepresented groups to apply.

Business Insider is a subsidiary of Axel Springer SE, a family-owned transatlantic media company headquartered in Berlin and New York. Axel Springer is dedicated to shaping the future of journalism in the free world, believing that a free and informed society is essential to democracy. The company’s guiding principles – first articulated as The Essentials by founder Axel Springer in the aftermath of World War II – remain a cornerstone of the company’s foundation today. title: Senior Space Build Reliability Engineer
description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Senior Space Build Reliability Engineer partners closely with the design and manufacturing teams to right-size processes and controls to enable scaling the production of spacecraft hardware. Build Reliability Engineers ensure production processes yield verified, reliable hardware at rate. You will flex beyond Build Reliability to support Quality, Flight Reliability, and Mission Assurance. The ideal candidate is a responsible, collaborative, process-oriented engineer with hands-on hardware design/test/manufacturing/troubleshooting experience.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with design engineering and manufacturing teams to create test, manufacturability, and inspection plans for all vehicle hardware.
  • Contain suspect or known non-conforming product, providing guidance to quality inspectors, technicians, shop supervisors, and engineers.
  • Lead failure investigations in production, test, and operation; identifying and mitigating immediate and underlying root causes to reduce risk and improve the reliability of designs and processes.
  • Provide critical peer review of hardware during design reviews and acceptance and qualification test campaigns.
  • Perform failure modes and effects analyses, build requirements compliance matrix tools, and ensure adequate test coverage, change management, and manufacturability of flight hardware.
  • Own vehicle level deliverables for regulatory bodies including requirements compliance, functional or flight hazard analyses, and verification evidence.
  • Support Mission Assurance's vehicle level risk management and identification/tracking/execution of mitigations.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in aerospace, computer science, electrical, manufacturing, mechanical, or material sciences engineering.
  • 5+ years professional experience in aerospace, design, quality, or related engineering role.
  • Hands-on hardware test, qualification, troubleshooting, or failure analysis experience.
  • Commitment to lean quality principles without compromising safety or reliability.
  • Demonstrated application of process controls in high volume manufacturing, test, and quality environments.
  • Experience generating, processing, and/or analyzing data for production insight.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaborative skills, with a drive to innovate and improve reliability in cutting-edge technology.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Full project lifecycle ownership experience (cradle-to-grave).
  • Proficiency with quality tools such as measurement systems analysis, design of experiments, statistical process control, root cause analysis and corrective action, advanced product quality planning (APQP), metrology, process failure mode and effects analysis (PFMEA), control plans, and various problem-solving approaches.
  • Hands-on knowledge of CNC machining, additive manufacturing, casting, welding, fastening, or other special manufacturing processes.

Pay Range

  • Salary range: Senior: $140,333 - $179,314/ per year.
  • This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA.
  • Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance.
  • You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards.

ITAR Requirements

Varda, like all employers, must ensure that its employees working in the United States are lawfully authorized to work in the U.S. Additionally, our employees are exposed to and have access to certain export-controlled items. Because our employees are provided access to export-controlled items, our policy is to only hire “U.S. persons” who are permitted to have access to our technology without an export license.

“US person” means: U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) (i.e., individual admitted to the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum).

title: Staff Product Manager, AI for Care
description:
Who We Are


Verily Health is a data platform and technology company purpose-built to power AI-enabled precision health solutions that accelerate research and improve care for individuals and communities. Uniquely positioned at the intersection of technology, data science, and healthcare, Verily transforms multimodal health data into insights, models, and actions that make healthcare more personalized, predictive, and precise.

Description


Verily Health builds healthcare solutions for customers in every vertical in the market from life sciences to health systems to health plans and to patients. Each of those solutions is powered by AI capabilities. where we need to continually verify that the output is meeting the needs of our end users.


You’ll own the product strategy for Verily’s AI Platform, the capabilities that first- and third-party AI developers use to benchmark, evaluate, monitor, and improve AI experiences in healthcare. Your first major initiative will be focused on our Evaluation Harness. AI evaluations across Verily’s solutions are paramount for establishing trust with our users and customers. The work will span everything from golden-dataset evals, code assertions, LLM-as-a-judge evals, error analysis, and customer feedback signals, from quick one-off checks to long-running validation for regulated use.


You’ll set a 12-month strategy and a longer vision for our AI Platform in healthcare, then lead a team of software engineers and AI developers, working beside them every day, to build it. The standard you set will shape how trustworthy healthcare AI gets made at Verily and beyond. We’re looking for someone who has a track record of building AI developer tooling and infrastructure and wants to define how the healthcare industry does it.

Responsibilities


  • Build a platform, not a point solution. Build evaluation tools for AI developers across many customers, verticals and clinical risk levels.
  • Obsess about user value. Name your end users, map their journeys, deeply understand their unmet needs, and conduct continuous discovery, delivery, and iteration with your team. You are directly responsible for end to end user value creation.
  • Build on Platform with technical credibility. Work as a peer with software architects, engineers, and data scientists on architecture and AI tradeoffs. Align solutions with Verily’s existing platform capabilities, and work with other teams to extend those capabilities in ways that scale the platform rather than create one-offs.
  • Compliance in healthcare. Align with subject matter experts across clinical, regulatory, quality, security, and data science to right-size and de-risk solutions for the business constraints we must operate within.
  • Own the AI Evaluation Harness portfolio. Drive the roadmap across error analysis, golden datasets, code assertions, LLM-as-a-judge, and customer feedback signals, and align stakeholders when interests conflict. Own product strategy and prioritization. Develop and communicate at different levels of detail and time horizon based on the audience; 12-month product strategy, half-year milestones, quarterly delivery roadmap, and biweekly sprint priorities. Set the direction, sequence the steps, and stay hands-on with the scrum team.

Qualifications


Minimum Qualifications


  • 5+ years of product management on platform products. You have been embedded with engineering scrum teams, and have a record of shipping and operating the product, not just specifying it.
  • Hands-on AI Evaluation product experience. You have shipped AI evaluation tooling that customers use (LLM-as-a-judge frameworks, golden datasets, code assertions and trace tooling). You can name the products, describe in detail the hard problems you solved, and show the adoption and quality outcomes for end users.
  • Deep technical foundation. You have a background in software engineering, systems engineering, data science, clinical informatics, or a comparable discipline. You can review architecture with engineers and go deep on LLM behavior with data scientists and be technically credible with them.
  • Stakeholder negotiation. You have aligned technical and non-technical leaders around one product vision, and can give examples where you moved a conflicted group to a decision.
  • Scale and complexity. You have owned a multi-tenant, version-controlled platform in a high-growth environment, with real tenancy, versioning, and backward-compatibility tradeoffs.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Healthcare domain fluency: FHIR resources, clinical informatics, and interoperability standards. You know what a “correct” clinical output requires and who must sign off on it.
  • Regulated environments: experience navigating HIPAA, GxP, FDA SaMD, or other healthcare compliance frameworks, ideally including building validation or audit evidence into a product.
  • Clinical Specific AI - Experience building evals for clinical or high-stakes AI outputs (summarization, coding, triage, decision support), including clinician-in-the-loop labeling and adjudication.

Qualified applicants must not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States.

title: Wild Area Officer - Wild Culm
location: Forestry England Halwill Office, Beaworthy, Devon
description:
• Job grade: Executive Officer
  • Contract type: Fixed term
  • Length of employment: until 31 March 2029
  • Business area: FC - Forestry England
  • Type of role: Other
